The speed of transition time between the synthesized frequencies gives the bandwidth of loop filter. In the dynamic CMOS logic PLL the power is reduced to 0.13mW and speed is improved to 0.50GHz.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of multi carrier PWM eleven level inverter with two modulation waves
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)

authors.preferredName: B. V. V. L. Kala Bharathi

abstract: Multilevel Inverter is introduced to reduce the switching stress and to obtain the output voltage with multiple steps to achieve the lowest total harmonic distortion (THD) and improved fundamental VRMS. This paper presents comparison of various methods used for reduction of THD and for improving VRMS. An eleven inverter is triggered by using Bipolar Multicarrier Pulse Width Modulation method, sine and Trapezoidal Amalgamated Rectangular (TAR) references with triangular carriers. There are seven various types of triangular carriers. They are, Phase Disposition, Phase Opposition Disposition, Alternate Phase Opposition Disposition, Carrier Overlapping, Phase Shift and Variable Frequency methods. The Performances measure like, THD, VRMS are evaluated for various modulation indices. Simulation is carried out by using MATLAB/SIMUINK. It is observed that sine reference based PWM method provides lower THD, TAR reference based PWM method provides higher fundamental VRMS output voltage.

articleTitle: Renewable energy through hydro power — A substantial source: Preventing global warming from becoming a planetary catastrophe may take something even more drastic than renewable energy, superefficient urban design, and global carbon taxes Jamais Cascio
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: India is a population rich country. Industrial revolution during the British reign has exploited the living standards of people in India by decreasing exports and increasing imports of British made products, but at the same time managed to inject technology into the country. progress was tremendous after independence and people gradually started depending on technological and other resources in order to survive including fossil fuels. Today there is an imperative call to stop sponsoring the usage of the fossil fuel industry, considerably diminish energy, and significantly change power supplies from oil, coal, and natural gas to wind, solar, geothermal, and other renewable energy sources. Hydropower is one such element where the energy can be restored and it is one of the oldest power sources on the planet, generating power when flowing water spins a wheel or turbine. It was used by farmers as far back as in ancient Greece for mechanical tasks like grinding grains. Hydropower is also a renewable energy source and produces no air pollution or toxic byproducts.

articleTitle: Digital artifacts-anti-forensics approach for optimization of digital images
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: To study the adaptive anti-forensic approach for optimization of digital images comprises of the various quantization and compression techniques. The technology and the changing methods of capturing digital images and the methodologies used are very powerful to identify the forgery in the image processing. As every new leap in the technology brings along positive and negative responses, similar way the technological changes in the field of image processing has led to forgery of digital images. The advancement in the techniques of digital image is used for processing millions of images those are captured every second.

articleTitle: Querying capability comparison of Hadoop technologies to find the more sustainable platform for big data
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: Big Data analytics is an upcoming field in the world of computing. It has much more complex requirements for processing and maintenance and thus it should be dealt using high-end servers. So, in turn, it has a lot more energy requirements. High energy requirements can lead to more energy wastage which is not a sustainable practice. In this paper, the comparison is done between 3 platforms that provide the framework for big data management. The platforms are Hive, Impala, and Spark. Many other platforms are also available but these three have been chosen because they can be easily implemented on even a single node Hadoop cluster. The results have shown that Cloudera Impala outperforms both the other platforms as it takes approximately 90% lesser time to do the same task.

articleTitle: Self-learning of braille using haptic interface for children
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: We are all aware of the hardships faced by the not so fortunate people. With the largest population of blind people in our country, we have proposed a system that would be beneficial for the visually impaired kids which will open the doors for them to lead a life that is, if not normal, at least close to normal. We believe that learning starts at a very young age; hence we have targeted children between the ages 3 to 6 and inculcate the basic concepts of Braille in our native language Tamil, such that they flourish in the future. We have created a Haptic Interface with the help of Arduino board and made use of Laptops for Automatic speech recognition that helps them in active learning. We have also included learning in various difficulty levels such as Easy, Intermediate, and Hard which would pop up based on the reactions and the answers given by them.

articleTitle: Partial PSO-PTS based PAPR reduction in MIMO OFDM
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: In OFDM, the difficulty of PAPR can be diminished to project numerous procedures. In this, one of the algorithms is PTS. PTS algorithm can be used to choose one cluster of progression of proper segment revolving feature optimization sub-block segment to accomplish least signal peak. In this process, the complicated task is removal of proper segment revolving feature. Therefore, an effectual PPSO-PTS (Partial Particle Swarm Optimization Partial Transmit Sequence) format is initiated in this paper for to conquer the problem. The projected process is executed in the functioning platform of MATLAB and the consequences were investigated by the existing method.

articleTitle: Vector dyadics radar imaging: Theory and validation
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: This paper discusses a technique based on a vector dyadic radar imaging of an unknown object (target) under test. With this inverse technique, an object is illuminated with a known incident wave, and parameter estimates for the target are derived via “reconstruction” analysis derived from geometric diversity data. The scattered field due to the contrast between the target and the surrounding media contains information such as target size, geometry and position. Inverse scattering techniques have been studied and used in applications such as radio frequency tomography, computed X-ray tomography, low frequency non-destructive test and evaluation, and geophysical remote sensing to render an image. One of the difficulties with imaging a target of interest through constrained illumination is complete reconstruction of the original object. In order to better exploit specular scattering from targets of interest, the model is based on the collection of finite dipoles and matrix vector dyadic green's function analysis of full body scattering.

articleTitle: Programmed image processing based dental image analysis
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: The length of root canal identification is the main issue in the dentistry around the world, which presently looks for the manual figuring keeping in mind the end goal to distinguish the estimation of the teeth. Power in homogeneity regularly is a noteworthy issue in dental x-beams which causes significant troubles in division. For better PC supported analysis in dentistry, having an exact tooth division is a basic undertaking, as the blisters and fiery injuries for the most part happen around tooth root ranges furthermore, these territories in radiographs are for the most part subject to clamor, poor complexity, and extremely uneven enlightenment. This paper presents a successful division strategy utilizing a combinational approach of Local Gaussian Distribution fitting vitality along with level sets. Here the nearby powers of pictures are characterized by Gaussian circulations which are consolidated with the level set work for exact divisions of teeth shape. The trial comes about demonstrate that division accomplishes the less number of emphases making it computationally quick and work in continuous circumstance.

articleTitle: Medical activity monitoring for elderly people using wearable wrist device
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: This paper discusses the design and implementation of a wearable sensor based framework for medical activity recognition of elderly patients. Tri-axial accelerometers worn on the dominant hand, monitor hand movements to recognize activities. Feature extraction is done based on Hilbert-Huang Transform (HHT) using Empirical Mode Decomposition (EMD). The dataset of activities is collected from 10 subjects and comprises of the following activities: opening a pill box, popping a pill into the mouth, drinking water, taking medicine in a syringe and self-injecting. Activities are classified using decision tree, k-nearest neighbor and support vector machine classifiers. The activity recognition system is integrated with a GSM modem that is used to automatically prompt appropriate alerts to caretakers about the patient's physical activities. This will have huge potential in reducing the cost of providing health care services to the elderly.

articleTitle: Implementation of energy based EDF, EDF-slack and EEA scheduling algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: Energy constrained systems such as sensor networks can increase their usable lifetimes by extracting energy from their environment. This is known as energy harvesting. Task scheduling at the single nodes should account for the properties of the regenerative energy source which fluctuates, capacity of the energy storage as well as deadlines of the time critical tasks. In this paper, we address the problem of scheduling periodic, possibly self-suspending, real-time tasks. We provide schedulability tests for EDF, EDF-Slack and EEA and a feasibility test using model checking.

articleTitle: Comparative of nonlinear tracking control techniques for the three-phase squirrel-cage induction motor positioning system
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: This paper is concerned with the design and implementation of a position adaptive nonlinear zero-dynamic tracking controller (ANZTC) for a three phase squirrel-cage induction motor. A linear extended state observer (LESO) is proposed to estimate a part of the system dynamics, but also to estimate the internal disturbances generated by parameter variation due to changes in the motor temperature. The estimated values by LESO observer are adapted to a nonlinear zero-dynamic controller in order to improve the trajectory tracking performance. Experimental results of the proposed controller and a classical field oriented control are compared. Both control techniques were implemented in a dSPACE®1104 equipment.

articleTitle: Secure voice over internet protocol(VoIP) network with biometric key
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: In a world that is more digitally connected than ever before, keeping your personal data safe is essential. Currently, Voice over Internet Protocol (VoIP) becomes one of the most dominant and attracting technologies in the world of telecommunications. The two major issues in VoIP is to be consider are that, the confidential data falling in the hands of network attackers and remembering of long cryptographic keys. Here we propose to generate a biometric key using iris, which is the combination of the iris code and the pseudo random numbers as a key for VoIP Communication. This iris key act as a symmetric key for both encryption and decryption. Unfortunately if the iris biometric is stolen, this makes the attacker to access the data if the data encrypted with biometric key alone. To overcome this problem we propose to use pseudo random numbers, which is fused with iris biometric. Therefore billions of unique keys can be generated, making VoIP technology hard for an attacker to guess the key. This proposed system is composed of two modules 1)Feature extraction of Iris 2)Cryptographic key generation.

articleTitle: Profile based classification of capacitors for reuse
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: In this paper we present the novel method of classification of through hole capacitors into two categories reusable and defective capacitors. Classification of three types of capacitors viz. color coded capacitors, ceramic disc capacitors and electrolyte capacitors has been achieved by applying profile based technique. Proposed method performs well under different background, different scaling, and illumination levels. Proposed method is fast as compared with template matching.

articleTitle: Implementation of parallel morphological filter with different structuring elements
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: This paper gives comparative analysis of parallel morphological filter with previously designed morphological filters. In this paper, implementation is done for gray image using various structuring elements. In past, multiple systems have been developed that have huge latency and fewer throughputs. This system reduced latency and improved through by using parallel approach. It provides a programmable and efficient implementation of basic morphological operators such as Dilation and Erosion using efficient parallel technique for different applications. It reduces processing time with respect to image dimension. Here performance analysis is based on different shape and size of structuring elements which support parallelism. MATLAB R2013a and Xilinx Design Suite 13.1 ISE are used for synthesizing this architecture that is verified by using Xilinx ISIM Simulator and prototyped on Spartan 3E FPGA Board. The proposed architecture is examined on different gray scale images.

articleTitle: Notice of Violation of IEEE Publication Principles: Information security in big data mining
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract:
Notice of Violation of IEEE Publication Principles

"Information Security in Big Data Mining"
by T. Revathi and V. Sudharsana
in the Proceedings of the IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI), 2017, pp.2045-2049

After careful and considered review of the content and authorship of this paper by a duly constituted expert committee, this paper has been found to be in violation of IEEE's Publication Principles.

This paper copied content from the paper cited below. The original content was copied without attribution (including appropriate references to the original author(s) and/or paper title) and without permission.

"Information Security in Big Data: Privacy and Data Mining"
by Lie Xu, Chunxiao Jiang, Jian Wang, Jian Yuan, and Yong Ren
in IEEE Access, October 2014, 1149-1176


The growing popularity and development of data mining technologies bring serious threat to the security of individual's sensitive information. An emerging research topic in datamining, known as Privacy Preserving Data Mining (PPDM), has been broadly contemplated as of late. The essential thought of PPDM is to adjust the information in such a route to perform data mining calculations viably without bargaining the security of delicate data contained in the information. Current investigations of PPDM for the most part concentrate on the best way to lessen the security hazard brought by data mining operations, while truth be told, undesirable divulgence of sensitive data may likewise occur during the time spent data gathering, data distributing, and data delivering. In this paper, we view the privacy issues related to datamining from a wider view point and examine different methodologies that can ensure delicate data. Specifically, we recognize four unique sorts of clients required in data mining applications, to be specific, data provider, data collector, data miner, and decision maker. For each kind of client, we examine his security concerns and the strategies that can be embraced to ensure sensitive data. We briefly present the nuts and bolts of related research topics, review state-of-the art approaches, and present Some preliminary thoughts on future research bearings. Other than investigating the protection safeguarding approaches for each sort of client, we additionally survey the amusement hypothetical methodologies, which are proposed for breaking down the associations among various clients in a datamining scenario, each of whom has his own valuation on the sensitive information. By differentiating the obligations of various clients regarding security of delicate data, we might want to give some valuable bits of knowledge into the investigation of PPDM.

articleTitle: A review of zero-voltage switching and its importance to voltage regulation
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: Step-down (“buck”) DC-DC voltage regulator circuit design is getting harder because power density (W/m3) is rising, DC power supply voltage levels are rising, and silicon voltage demands are dropping in order to increase efficiency. The difference between the supply voltage and that required by the silicon creates a big drop across the regulator, increasing switching losses and ultimately limiting the device's switching frequency.

articleTitle: Imaging and analyzing a target buried in a two different inhomogeneous lossy medium
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: This paper discusses, analysis and images a thin cylinder buried inside two different lossy medium. A fast and sophisticated reconstruction technique for ground penetrating radar (GPR) is used to create the 2D image of the buried target. To reconstruct a 2D image a date is collected from multiple angles via numerical discretization technique. This led creating a high-resolution 2D image. This approach requires less computational power and simple way to implement a relative matrix inversion. The primary benefits, as compared to other GPR imaging methods, are improved resolution and 2D imaging for easy survey analysis. Furthermore, probe calibration and background subtraction methods were utilized to remove all the clutter around the target. The probe calibration technique is very helpful especially when the electromagnetic wave is propagating in an inhomogeneous lossy medium which the clutter around the target may mask the target of interest. The experiment was conducted in Mumma Radar Lab (MRL) at the University of Dayton which equipped to perform this kind of complex work.

articleTitle: Characterization of microstructures using white light diffraction phase microscopy
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: We present results from the characterization of microstructures using white light Diffraction Phase Microscopy technique, which combines the single shot imaging attributes of the off-axis geometry and speckle free imaging attribute of white light. A microscope with a halogen lamp and a Mach-Zehnder interferometer combined to obtain images of the specimen. A conventional phase reconstruction algorithm is applied to retrieve the phase information, which includes the unwrapping algorithm to avoid problem associated with the thick objects. We demonstrate 3D imaging and quantification of the depth of microstructures.

articleTitle: A distributed algorithm for local decision of cluster heads in wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: Clustering is a preferred method to save energy in Wireless sensor networks by assigning role of relaying and aggregation to nodes called cluster heads. These are elected among all nodes based on certain criteria that differ from technique to technique. Moreover, for even distribution of load, the CHs are re-elected after regular intervals. Recently, nature-inspired techniques for optimization are being used for CH election through construction of appropriate objective functions. But such global objective functions require information of entire network and generate much overhead. This paper proposes local objective functions so that a distributed control algorithm can be designed and local election is performed.

articleTitle: Analysis and validation of spacecraft statistical data
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: The cartosat series of satellites is a high resolution earth imaging satellite in the advanced cartographic missions. It has various sub systems like attitude and orbit control, command processing, data acquisition, telemetry, thermal management, payload interface, MIL-STD-1553B interface with other sub systems of the spacecraft etc. Phased Array Antenna (PAA) is one such sub system which is electronically steerable antenna capable of transmitting payload data uninterruptedly. This satellite revolving around the earth keeps changing the angle between the satellite and earth station continuously. The phase array antenna consists of individual antenna elements mounted on hemispherical dome. Each element is connected to one of the four ports of a switch. This paper primarily defines the automation of PAA testing and approach for implementing the automation for validating the system. The look angles that is azimuth and elevation can be tested for all the specified range and to cover all the PAA elements. A report is generated automatically which logs the results of testing, which helps for further analysis. This automation can be used for any future projects which trim down lot of time during project realization.

Author Keywords: AV-SSD (Analysis and Validation of Spacecraft Statistical Data)

articleTitle: Dynamic constrained low altitude flight maneuvers with constant energy
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: This paper introduces the so called Energy Constant Trajectories (ECT) for low-level flights as well as trajectory planning in TF/TA maneuvers in mountainous areas. A typical ECT is developed thru incorporating terrains as some constraints into the dynamics of the flying aircraft. This strategy leads to an identifier for the control variable boundaries which in turn, simplifies the optimum decision making process. In fact, the dynamical system reduces to a constrained control variable problem for a significantly simpler system which considers only the kinematic equations of motion. Numerical results for an arbitrary 3/D flight show that this approach improves the reliability of the guidance law that needs to be followed by the aircraft over a given terrain.

articleTitle: Automatic protective headgear for safer ride
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: In India approximately more than 37 million people are using two wheelers. Also a report says that in India on an average of 17 people dies every hour. The primary concern is to provide safety to the person while riding the bike. The government is imposing the rules for the two wheeler drivers to wear helmet during driving. But the negligence of the driver is the major factor of road accidents. In order to overcome this, an automatic protective headgear system for safe riding is suggested and implemented in this paper. This system includes a headgear controlled safety system using RF module to ensure that the bike rider wears a helmet. The system also includes additional features to detect alcohol consumption of the driver, theft of the bike, bike security and also locality of the bike in the case of accident.

articleTitle: Sensor-free automation of buildings to conserve the light energy without sacrifice in the visual comfort through image processing techniques
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: Automating the buildings leads to efficient operation especially in office workspaces. In buildings, automation is d one mostly on HVAC systems and Lighting systems. Lighting Systems is one area where energy can be conserved. Understanding this many lighting control techniques have been developed for providing automation in Lighting systems. There are many difficulties faced in the automating the buildings, like number of sensors increases with increase in building area, transmitting information and centralized control. The main aim of this paper is automating the lighting systems in the office building to conserve and control light energy without sacrificing the visual comfort through image processing with the help of cameras used for surveillance systems. An added advantage is that we can save the cost of investment in the sensors.

articleTitle: Fuzzy based power control of inter line HVDC network
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: This paper defines a fuzzy based power controller have ability to control and improves power of HVDC grid tied system. It can control the flow of current effectively due to its fast acting and effectively error reduction ability. It can control the active power effectively with VSC converter. The proposed controller can improves the fault ride through capability of HVDC transmission system by incorporating effective current controller to limit fault current in prescribed limit.

articleTitle: Web searches for visual content: A multiple classifier approach
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: Though CBIR field has acquired much wide popularity, CBIR has not yet reached its mellowness and is not yet being used on a large scale. In this paper problem of using single classifier for searching the images in the huge database by providing image or its rough sketch as a query is removed up to certain extent. In order to used single classifier for image classification it produce numerous drawbacks so to avoid this problem a systems comprising of a pool of classifier has to be designed which generates the output which is complement of each other. In This Paper Various concepts regarding CBIR like objectives while designing a CBIR system, Problems associated while designing an efficient CBIR system, Analysis of KNN classifier for this system and a new system is proposed which overcomes the drawback of using existing methods in terms of computational time and correctness.

articleTitle: An implementation of secure image transmission using gold codes
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: This paper proposes an implementation of secure image transmission using gold codes. First of all the analog image is converted into digital image and encoded by absolutely addressed Picture Element (APEL) Encoder as a source coding. Further the digital data are encoded by the Gold Encoder as a channel coding to convert an image into the most appropriate form used to transmit over the communication channel and the output of the channel encoder is transmitted through the communication channel by the CDMA Transmitter for secure transmission. The Rake Receiver is used to receive the CDMA signal and then decoded the transmitted sequence to obtain an original image.

articleTitle: A survey on adaptive learning authoring tools
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: This paper surveys various adaptive learning authoring tools which are widely used. It has been done to propose different methods to implement the adaptive learning more effectively. Based on the pre-requisits and the type of metholdogy employed in each author tool, it can be effectively and efficiently used. Adaptive learning is essential for e-learning systems which dynamically adapts learning content based on learner's requirement and skill. To enhance author's efficiency, e-learning systems must definitely understand the learners requirements. Each work has its own working methodology, advantages and limitations.

articleTitle: The efficient data collection in wireless sensor network structure using ETRSP approach (Encroach traffic reconnect set-up partitioning)
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: In wireless sensor network various Technique have been suggested for re-establish connectivity and energy consumption while efficient data collection ETRSP (Encroach Traffic Reconnect Set-Up Partitioning) Technique is proposed for finding irregularities in path while transmission. The proposed technique is used for reconstructing the network according to network framework. and provide optimal and reliable path for data transmission in network. The result form proposed technique shows better performance as compared to previous technique.

articleTitle: TCR designing to minimize the voltage fluctuation within 5% of three phase arc furnace
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: Electric Arc Furnaces (EAFs) are unbalanced nonlinear and time varying loads, which can cause many problems in the power system quality. Then by considering the high changes of reactive power and volts flicker of nonlinear heater load, thyristor manipulated reactor compensation with thyristor switched capacitor (TCR) are made and simulated.

articleTitle: A robust deep learning mechanism augmented with cellular automata for DNA computing
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)

authors.preferredName: N. S S S N Usha Devi

abstract: Deep Learning is the investigation of how a normal computer augmented with different computing technique can explore how it can separate the examples in their particular fields, and make clever actions in light of the sort and classifications of the example. Deep Learning is knowledge able about an extensive variety of human movement. In a more extensive view, it will cover any setting where a few forecasts are made on the promptly accessible information. Deep Learning manages the advancement of a technique, which is to be connected to an arrangement of conceivable sources of info; the strategy developed will allocate a class from an arrangement of classes to another information, in light of its watched highlights. We propose a novel Deep learning component for quicker DNA processing. We have taken CA(Supervised) for preprocessing the initial DNA sequences. The results prove an increase of accuracy of prediction and false prediction ratio by 12.3%.

articleTitle: A precise positioning conditional probability estimator for fixed width booth multipliers
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: This brief proposes a Precise Positioning Conditional Probability (PPCP) estimator for the compensated circuit of the fixed width booth multipliers for various column length for truncation part, w. Unlike the previous works, the proposed work is carried out on the basis of entire zero and non-zero codes based on where it occurs. This PPCP estimator is used in the truncation part to reduce the errors incurred during the fixed width multiplication process. While comparing with the previous works, the proposed work is proved to be a precise one as the probability process is done based on positioning. Also an area efficient architecture of PPCP estimator is proposed. The final results of this brief show that the given multiplier is the most accurate and an area efficient one.

articleTitle: Event based query offloading in mobile cloud computing
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: An integral network issue in cloud computing for mobile environments is service availability. For a mobile user the connection to the cloud maybe difficult to obtain due to traffic congestion, failure of network and weak signal. In mobile cloud computing, the concept of distributed query processing takes place which relates to the data distribution across multiple machines and we need to process queries. This paper aims to determine what computation to place where in a network scenario. This motivates event based adaptive query processing. Data query operators need to generate events, much like exceptions in a programming environment which need to be handled by the query processor. The overall aim of the paper is to analyze efficient query processing when an event occurs and calculate the minimum query response time in three network scenarios based on capabilities and factors of a local, adhoc network and mobile cloud environment.

articleTitle: Hadoop based short — term traffic flow prediction on D2its using correlation model and KNN HSsine
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: This big-data-driven traffic flow prediction systems presents a new MapReduce based nearest neighbour (NN) approach for traffic flow prediction using data correlation analysis (TFPC) on a Hadoop platform. KNN HSsine introduce a realtime prediction system on Hadoop platform by using haversine distance function. Further KNN HSsine preforms analysis using two classifiers parallel k-nearest neighbour optimization classifier and Haver sine K-nearest neighbour optimization classifier, which incorporates data correlation information among traffic flows into the classification process. Finally we propose a novel prediction calculation method, combining the current data observed in prediction phase and the classification results obtained from large-scale historical data in the classification phase, to predict traffic flow in real time. Finally the accuracy is evaluated by using four metrics MAPE, RMSE, MAE, ME. accuracy results shows that KNN HSsine gives better performance than parallel k-nearest neighbor optimization classifier using euclidean distance.

articleTitle: The driver factors impact on road traffic safety research
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: Based on the NaSch model, this paper establishes a cellular automaton traffic flow model considering driver characteristics is established in this paper. The vehicle driving characteristics under the disturbance of the driver are simulated. Numerical analysis shows that at low density, the maximum speed can be reached without the driver interference factor. With the increase of density, the critical density of the system is larger and the influence of driver behavior on traffic flow is increased. When the driver's interference factor is below the p=0.8 ratio, the impact of the system's flow is tiny and the purpose of safe driving is achieved by observing the trend of traffic. However, when the driver interference factor ratio is large, in the high density area, the system traffic will be more affected, the traffic than the above situation is smaller.

articleTitle: A novel spice integrated approach for modeling of equivalent circuit of SR motor for critical behavioral analysis
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: This paper presents a novel improved spice integrated approach for static, steady state and dynamic behavioral analysis of Switch Reluctance Motor using its equivalent circuit. The cogging torque minimization at the base speed during various load condition is studied. Various modes were developed using analog behavior modeling technique in the spice. The mathematical model is developed for all the four quadrant modes of operation. The experimentation is carried out for validation of proposed work.

articleTitle: Image processing application for non destructive testing
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: Surface deformation is a common problem faced by automobile industry. The status of mechanical components are to be monitored day in day out to have high reliability and in this paper a method based on image processing algorithm at its first phase is proposed which analyses the tire part and gives out its acceptance or its rejection. The paper is based on the concept of pattern recognition since these patterns can be intelligently and algorithmically used to address many issues and the paper works on the fact that every image is having a well known singular value matrix which can be resolved easily to analyze various aspects. The paper demonstrates the results using Image processing Tool Box on Matlab platform.

articleTitle: A power electronic design approach to a power supply unit for A1kW high-frequency transmitter in naval applications
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: This paper is aimed at design, analysis and implementation of 1kW power supply unit for high-frequency transmitter in naval applications. Most of the equipments used by Army/Navy are based on 42V DC supply. Hence developing a PSU, that produces 42V DC from AC mains play a vital role. The design prototype consists of a boost power factor correction (PFC) circuit, half-bridge inverter followed by a rectifier. Power conversion process consists of two stages. In this work AC to DC conversion topology is used, however it is necessary to keep additional control circuitry to control power factor. In order to maintain good power factor, a boost Power Factor Correction (PFC) circuit is employed. The proposed AC/DC converter is designed to operate at 100 kHz. Further the proposed AC/DC converter illustrates achievement of line, load regulation and good power factor as per design requirements. Also ripples obtained are within the safe limits and design is validated using experimental results.

articleTitle: Controlling of torque and flux for 3φ induction machine drive system (IMDS) using fuzzy controller (theory and introductory concepts)
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: In recent years, the application fields of direct torque control of induction drives have greatly increased in the areas of steel industry, paper mills and power plants and so on. It is based on decoupled flux and torque providing a very quick and robust response with a simple control construction in Alternating Current drives. Major improvement in modern industrial process over the past 50 years can be largely attributed to advance in variable speed motor drives. Prior to 1950s most of the industries use DC motors because three-phase induction motor could only be operated at standard frequency. Now thanks for the advancement in power electronic devices and the advent of DSP technology, which is fast, reliable and cost effective for the control of induction motors. In this paper, induction motor drives, Matlab simulink and the control strategy for induction drives have been discussed.

articleTitle: Design and analysis of highly nonlinear multi-core PCF with hybrid cladding for CWDM systems
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: In this paper, tetra-core and dual-core photonic crystal fiber (PCF) with hybrid cladding have been suggested for coarse wavelength division multiplexing (CWDM) systems. The designing parameters have reformed to optimize the optical properties of the proposed structure. Finite element method (FEM) is utilized to perform the numerical analysis of the proposed S-PCF. Also, The proposed tetra-core PCF exhibits a negative dispersion about -631 ps/nm.km and high nonlinearity of 8.268×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">13</sup> W<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>km<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> at a wavelength of 1550 nm. On the another side, the dual-core PCF exhibits a negative dispersion about -6.801 ps/nm.km and high nonlinearity of 8.268×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">13</sup> W<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>km<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> at a wavelength of 1550 nm. Besides Effective area and field distribution are also described briefly.

articleTitle: Naturalness improvement in text to speech synthesis using threshold amplitude of the syllable (Marathi language)
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: This paper presents approach to concatenation of syllable like units to produce speech output from the text input. In the development of a speech synthesis system, unit selection and concatenation is an important stage. The main goal of the talk is to increase cooperation between the speech coding community and the TTS community, and in particular to motivate the need for speech coding algorithms that meet the requirements of the next generation speech synthesis technology. Here, a threshold point of amplitude is used for concatenation of two words while synthesizing the whole sentence.

articleTitle: Sensorless stator field-oriented digital control of induction motor based on LQR theory with augmented integral error
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: This paper proposes a sensorless digital speed control of induction motor, based on optimal Linear Quadratic Regulator (LQR) theory with PI structure, through stator field orientation. The discretized state space model of induction motor (IM) system is augmented with sum of instantaneous output error as additional state to enhance reference tracking in presence of disturbance and parameter uncertainty. A model reference adaptive system (MRAS) for speed estimation is derived in discrete time domain and is implemented with an effort to eliminate differential terms and resistance terms in the reference model. In addition, a stator model based Kalman filter is implemented and the responses of both the observers are compared in context with the stator field oriented discrete time LQR control strategy. The performance of the control strategy and observer performances are found to be satisfactory with variation in speed reference and load torque.

articleTitle: Wireless encrypted GPS device to device data transfer and tracking system
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: Tracking system is used for the observing of persons or objects location in motion or stands still and supplies periodically sequence of location data to a monitoring system. Nowadays, tracking systems are playing a key role in domestic and industrial area. There is range of tracking systems available but no single low power system that integrates all tracking of any movable objects. The present work is to develop an Android based Smart tracking system where authorized user gets all status of device on his mobile phone. In this project, Advance Encryption Standard algorithm (AES) is implemented to encrypt GPS and sensor parameters. DragonBoard410c is used as SBC which has a high performance Qualcomm Snapdragon processor used for IoT platform. The presented work concentrates on the wireless Encrypted GPS and sensor data communication between the device and user's mobile via Internet and how to access and monitor sensor parameters. This tracking system is low in size, power consumption.

articleTitle: Wi-Fi signal measurement and identification of dead zones
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: Now-a-days Wi-Fi is used almost everywhere as a local area network. Generally, in campus wide networks, there are places in which the signal strength is very week or there is no signal. This causes the non-connectivity of the persons in that zone and some very urgent and important communications may be lost. We have attempted to solve this Coverage problem by identifying the locations/zones where there is a poor signal strength using coverage tool and Google maps. In this work, we have identified the dead zones of the network and proposed locations of the APs (access points) to have optimum coverage of the campus.

articleTitle: Multiport inverter with AC-link
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: Multiport Inverter, a justified concept for hybrid power sources. For integrating power conversion in a hybrid source, single power processing stage is used to interface multiple power inputs. The multiport layout ensures the centralized control as well as compact packaging. In this paper a three-port, the multiport inverter is simulated and elaborated switching strategy is provided with three power ports interlinked to a single power conversion stage.

articleTitle: Transmission congestion management perspectives in deregulated scenario: A survey
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: Since last two decades, Indian electricity markets are deregulated, with which generation and consumption of electricity are increasing unanticipatedly. At the same time transmission sectors are not growing satisfactory due to many limitations like existing grid aging, very high cost of building new lines, permitting delays etc. Which has led to the difficulties in accommodating all power transactions as transmission system are operated near to their full capacity in deregulated environment to satisfy the demand. Optimal utilization of transmission network without congestion is the main focus of ISO now days. This paper focuses on to unite assorted publications of transmission congestion management methods which can be an anther solution to building newer lines.

articleTitle: State of the art review of speech recognition using genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: In recent years, speech recognition has become of the most emerging topic for many researchers. Speech is one of the most important tools for communication between human and his environment. People are so easeful with speech that they would also like to intercommunicate with computers via speech, rather than having to apply to ancient adapters. This paper covers mainly two topics firstly, what are the different speech recognition techniques and secondly, how genetic algorithm helps in speech recognition.

articleTitle: Experimental analysis of a multi-sponge liner basins techniques of solar distillation
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: An experimental analysis of a multi - sponge liner basins solar still is a device that produces clean, drinkable water from the Saline water by using the energy of the sun. In this a Double Slope - multi - basin Solar still has been performed on clear sunny day on summer and winter seasons at Vel Tech Multitech Dr. Rangarajan Dr. Sakunthala Engineering College, Avadi, at Chennai in Tamil Nadu India March 2016 to April 2017. The experimental analyses of the system have been shown that the first, second and third basin contributes 36.21%, 34.04 % and 29.05% of the total distillate yield respectively. He experimental analysis of Tribasin solar still have been made for one of the typical days calculation improve with other solar still.

articleTitle: Determining operating voltage of a given inverter subject input parameters variations for minimum output variations: Using standard deviation approach
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: In this paper, it is shown that how using simple statistical measures like the standard deviations from target value can be used to determine the operating input voltage of a given inverter. The output voltage magnitude and its quality profile are a function of both the Input DC voltage and the firing angle. Any variation in these two factors, forces the output of the inverter to vary. This method is not to be used to make changes in the design of the inverter, but rather use the existing inverter at such a voltage level and firing angle, so that the output voltage variation per unit change in any input parameters is minimum. For practically implementing the proposed method, for deciding the input operating voltage, there is no need to know the mathematical model or the topology of the inverter, but the data for calculations is generated by subjecting the inverter to different input conditions of the allowable range of voltage and firing angle. In this paper the method has been demonstrated using Matlab simulations, to show how only meeting the output voltage conditions is not sufficient, and in some cases even the THD profile too can produce comparable results, making it difficult to decide amongst the probable choices of input voltage. Simulink analysis and other statistical tools have been used to authenticate the observations and conclusions.

articleTitle: Three dimensional vision system around vehicle
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: The recent automotive ADAS (Advanced Driver Assistance System) technology is consist of 360 degree view camera system around a vehicle. The 360 degree view camera system around a vehicle supports the driver during drive the vehicle. The system is assembling around the vehicle by using four fish eye cameras attached to the vehicle, each camera capturing a four different direction around vehicle. We deploped a real time three dimensional vision system around vehicle that can secure safe driving. The System consist of camera calibration method specially for produce inverse prospective mapping of captured images onto 3D bowl model. The four images from camera stitched on bowl geometry and rendered as third person point of view. This system is mainly remove blind spot problem of vehicle. The system runs on DSP C66x processor to produce three dimensional vision system around vehicle.

articleTitle: Evaluation and classification of AD in magnetic resonance images on hippocampus region using support vector machines
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: The identification of several behavioral symptoms is often mistakenly associated to the age-related concerns or stress in Alzheimer's disease. The correct diagnosis and monitoring of the disease requires of additional resources. A new methodology for classification of Alzheimer's disease is from MR images for medical support. A large database with more than five hundred patient's images was used. Two different problems are tackled in this work: a first one where a classification method is developed to classify MR images as either normal or with the Alzheimer's disease and a second one for the identification and classification between normal subjects, MCI patients and AD patients. It is noteworthy we could offer a tool support vector machines to assist the early diagnosis of dementia. The outline of the methodology includes wavelet feature extraction from the MRIs, dimensionality reduction, training-test subdivision and classification using Support Vector Machines.

articleTitle: Digital synthetic ripple modulator for DC-DC converter
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: The digital control based synthetic ripple modulator generates the duty ratio with inverse relation to a sampled converter parameter. The on-time and off-time duration of the switches forming the duty ratio is generated by successively accumulating the sampled inductor voltage. The accumulated output forming the synthetic ripple is added to the error between output voltage and reference voltage which act like feed forward system. The carrier signal thus generated is modulated between the higher and lower hysteretic thresholds, thus generating the duty ratio. A scaling process also allows the implementation of programmable switching frequency for synchronous buck converter.

Author Keywords: metal oxide semiconductor field effect transistor

articleTitle: Novel 8-Port Hybrid Parabolic Taper Transmission Line Type
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: Parabolic Taper Transmission Line Type 8-Port Hybrid is analyzed. The solution is used to design microwave 8-Port Hybrid. The parameters of this network is calculated and its frequency responses is computed. Simulation design and manufacturing of microwave Parabolic Taper Transmission Line Type 8-Port Hybrid are presented.

articleTitle: Optimized hydel-thermic operative outlining using grey-wolf optimizing technique
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: Present concise implements a newly advanced Grey-Wolf optimization (GWO) to attain optimized hydel-thermic operative outlining considering several boundings. Operative principle of the GWO incorporates the leading ability based rankings along with target trapping ability of a grey type wolf for exploring the universal solutions or solutions nearby to it. In the presented concise, the GWO has been adopted to enhance converging speed and to improve results benchmark by implementing it on a hydel-thermic network. The network involves back to back linking of multiple tanks. In it, confined operating sections and the loading influence of valve point have been considered for hydel and thermic producers sequentially. A comparative analysis has been made between results of the GWO and those of established techniques. A convergence matching-up between the GWO and particle swarm optimizing technique (C-PSO) has been carried out. It demonstrated that the GWO converges in a superior manner than the C-PSO.

articleTitle: A TLBO algorithm based optimal load scheduling of generators for power system network
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: This paper discusses about ELD Problem is modeled by non-convex functions. These are problem are not solvable using a convex optimization techniques. So there is a need for using a heuristic method. Among such methods Teaching and Learning Based Optimization (TLBO) is a newly known algorithm and showed promising results. This paper utilized this algorithm to provide load dispatch solutions. Comparisons of this solution with other standard algorithms like Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), Differential Evolution (DE) and Harmony Search Algorithm (HSA). This projected algorithm is implemented to resolve the ELD problem for 6 unit and 10 unit test systems along with the other algorithms. This comparison investigation explored various merits of TLBO with respect to PSO, DE, and HSA in the field economic load dispatch.

articleTitle: New method for missile control using sliding mode control
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: A new method is introduced and simulated for control of pursuit missiles. The method implements a nonlinear model and a sliding mode controller is designed for the system to cope with unknown parameters such as aerodynamic coefficients and moment of inertia and to make the system robust. Simulation results show satisfactory performance in terms of efficiency and stability for sliding mode controller and optimal behavior when applied to the linear model.

articleTitle: Transformerless grid tied inverter using neutral point clamped full bridge topologies and hybrid filter for THD reduction
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: In photovoltaic applications, it is possible to remove the transformer in the inverter to reduce losses, costs, and size. Galvanic connection of the grid and the dc sources in transformer less systems can introduce additional ground currents due to the ground parasitic capacitance. The leakage current has to be tackled carefully for such type of inverter topologies. Neutral point clamped (NPC) topology is an effective way to eliminate the leakage current. A universal prototype for these three NPC-type topologies is built to evaluate the topologies at conversion efficiency and the leakage current characteristic. The PN-NPC topology exhibits similar leakage current with the FB-DCBP, which is lower than that of the oH5 topology, and features higher efficiency than both the oH5 and the FB-DCBP topologies. Total harmonic distortion of NPC topologies will get better with Hybrid filters.

articleTitle: Microchannels on silica surface using femtosecond laser pulses
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: Femtosecond laser-induced micro or nanoscale periodic structure on silica glass is still an area of interest due to its application in manufacturing of optoelectronics devices and medical devices. The study of surface modification in micron level was carried out in using Ti: Sapphire femtosecond laser pulse of pulse duration 100 fs at 800 nm at a repetition rate of 1 kHz. The microchannels are created at different fluence and scanning velocity with the linearly polarized pulse. The variation of the width and the depth are optimized with respect to the laser fluence and scanning velocity.

articleTitle: Intelligent and robust control of DER for autonomous microgrid operation
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: Voltage and frequency variations are often observed when a DER is interconnected to the utility grid. These variations can be managed with effective control of the PE interface of the DER to the grid. This paper investigates the use of an intelligent controller using active power control in the dq0 frame for addressing the frequency and voltage imbalance when a DER is interconnected to the utility. The proposed strategy developed also investigates the subsequent reactions on the distribution network when various scenarios occur which may lead to the formation of a microgrid (MG). The intelligent controller which is based on the mamdani model, displays satisfying results which show effective grid side control of the DER. The simulation results are compared to an intelligent controller using the TSK model and the mamdani model is validated based on the effective frequency and voltage stability.

articleTitle: Experimental evaluation of model predictive control using data driven models
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: The Single Board Heater System (SBHS) can be chosen as the system which may find many analogous industrial applications where acute temperature control is demanded. The basic requirement in process control industry is the development of good model for the betterment of controller behavior, hence the fundamental task for any control problem is the development of model for the process to be controlled and design of controller using the model developed. The system identification of the process is done by using data driven or black box modeling. Model Predictive Control (MPC) is a control strategy that was developed in the process control industries to deal with constraints during operation of the plant and multivariable interactions. MPC can be formulated as : A nearly accurate model for given system, possible effects of the current and future manipulated input on the future plant dynamics can be predicted on-line and used to choose the input moves optimally [1]. The on-line predictions can be done over a window moving with time. The efficacy of these algorithms is tested through a Single Board Heater System which is temperature control process with heater and fan. The analysis of the control algorithms is done using LabVIEW and Matlab.

articleTitle: Metaheuristic strategies Bi-objective for the resolution of combinatorial optimization problems
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: In the real world, there is a wide amount of optimization issues, in which classical methods of mathematics programming can't guarantee the most optimum solution. Evolutional algorithms are metaheuristics. Over the last years have become more popular due to their conceptual simplicity and their efficiency in this type of issues. These algorithms have been used successfully in the area of multi-objective optimization, because of their nature. Based in populations demos, which allows generating several solutions from the conjuncts of optimums in one execution. Unfortunately, when the objective functions is computer costly to assess, the evolutional algorithms become impractical. In this paper we present a hybrid algorithm based in Pareto and Colony of Ants for the optimization of combinatory issues Bi-Objective.

articleTitle: Image enhancement with histogram local minimas
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: In this paper work, the author introduces local minima based image enhancement. Enhancing of images is a primary step in any advanced image processing analysis. Initially, the histogram of an unprocessed image is computed to analyze the gray level distribution of an image. Later the local minima's of histogram image is calculated. Based on these minima's the image is partitioned in to intensity based distributed images. Finally these images undergo mapping process with mean and equalization computational values. The effectiveness of proposed work is verified with PSNR (peak signal to noise ratio), entropy, AMBE (Absolute mean brightness error) & visual quality in both quantitatively, qualitatively.

articleTitle: Effect of data hiding using the new PVD approach in various file formats — A comparative study
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: This paper aims at analyzing the outcome of the new Pixel Value differencing approach by embedding data in different file formats. Data is hidden in the spatial domain of the image. The new Steganographic method is based on the difference between the value of the secret message and the value of the cover image pixel. In other PVD approaches embedding is done taking into consideration the difference between adjacent pixels in the cover image. To analyze the efficiency of the method, the values of MSE (Mean Square Error), PSNR (Peak Signal to Noise Ratio) and Mean Error Rate are calculated and compared while embedding in various file formats. The idea behind this comparative study is to find the best file format that can be selected for effective steganographic communication. The file formats jpeg, bmp, png and tiff are considered.

articleTitle: Study and analysis of communication logic between FPGA and the server
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: The ZYNQ is an all programmable system on chip (APSoC). The ZYNQ 7020 is used as a target board in this design [1]. The APSoC has two parts PS and PL. The paper objective is to develop the communication between the Zynq PS and the server or host PC [2]. The stream of data packets are sent from the PL part of the APSoC and stored in the DDR3 memory. The stored data packets are read by using the ARM Cortex A9 processors. Those data packets are transferred to the external PC through Ethernet. To implement this Xilinx Vivado and SDK tools are used.

articleTitle: Electric field analysis of polymer insulators for various geometrical configurations
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: Present days, electrical field distribution is the region of major concern in the service life of polymeric Insulators. Numerous methodologies are suggested to analyze the electric field along the insulators both experimentally and numerically of which the former might be more time consuming, requiring a number of trial-error tests to decide the optimum dimensions. The dawn of super computers makes numerical analysis feasible on any intricate geometry. Insulators will degrade and fail due to the existence of higher electrical stresses. These electrical stresses can be minimized with change in the geometrical configurations of the insulator. Here in this paper, with the help of FEMM 2D software package 11kV and 33kV polymer insulators are designed and electric field distribution at different critical points is analyzed. The electric stresses are reduced with the change in the geometrical configurations mainly the size and shape of the insulator. Results are compared between the actual design of the insulator and the insulator with the change in the geometrical configurations. It is observed that the insulator with change in geometrical configurations gives better field results.

articleTitle: Mitigation of total harmonic distortion using cascaded MLI-DSTATCOM in distribution network
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: In this modern generation almost every power supplies are non-linear loads which contains electronic devices that do not conduct current over the full cycle of the applied voltage, and thus they introduce harmonics into the power network. Electronic front end of non linear load makes them more efficient than linear loads and these non-linear front ends are one of the source of harmonic. Harmonic is nothing but a signal or a wave having frequency is an integral (whole-number) multiple of the frequency of some reference signal or wave or fundamental frequency. Harmonic causes losses in the power distribution network and can lead to increased cost due to maintenance, failures or device de-rating and thus decreases the power quality of the power distribution network. Power quality may be defined as a set of electrical characteristics that allows a piece of equipment to function in its desired manner without any interruption and significant loss of performance or life expectancy. Total harmonic distortion (THD) is an important figure of merit used to quantify the level of harmonics in voltage or current waveforms. In this paper Distribution Static Compensator (DSTATCOM) with Synchronous Reference Frame based control which taking into account Three-Level Cascaded multi level Inverter for minimization of harmonics in Power System. This Three level Cascaded multilevel inverter supply low harmonics distortion, reduced number of switches, suppression of switching losses and take out the Total Harmonics Distortion (THD).

articleTitle: Multicast routing selection for VANET using hybrid scatter search ABC algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: VANET has become very interesting and challenging area of research in recent years. VANET is a special class of Adhoc Network. VANET is an autonomous and self - configured wireless network. The highly dynamic environment and constrained mobility of VANET need efficient routing and resource sharing. Most of the applications in VANET require group communication. Group communication is facilitated by multicast routing. Many existing conventional protocols are not suitable for multicasting. In this paper a new multicast routing specially designed for VANET to meet challenges of multicasting is proposed.

articleTitle: A −38 to 57dB 26.6MHz 1.96mW with 73.22dB SNDR variable gain amplifier in 0.18μm CMOS
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: This paper proposes a new reliable method to achieve a wideband dynamic range of DC gain, suitable bandwidth (-3dB) with high linearity and low power consumption in a Variable Gain Amplifier (VGA). Utilizing the proposed idea, the VGA achieve DC gain range of -38 to 57dB and 26.6 MHz (-3dB) bandwidth as well. Meanwhile, the SNR and Unity Gain Bandwidth (UGB) of the proposed VGA are 74dB and 3.32GHz respectively. It is noteworthy that, the proposed idea is applicable to apply on every fully differential amplifier too. Besides, the power consumption of the suggested VGA is 1.96mW with the power supply of 1.8 volts properly, and 1.2pF capacitor load is applied at the output nodes of the amplifier. Furthermore, the proposed structure is simulated in different temperatures in the region of -55 to +95 °C and whole process corners condition. Simulations are performed by HSPICE using the BSIM3 model of the 180nm CMOS technology.

articleTitle: Application of fuzzy logic for evaluating the influence of panchagavya on tomato yield in grow bags: Fuzzy logic for tomato yeild
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: Application of engineering algorithms for varied branches of applied sciences is reliable. This paper props up the concept of application of fuzzy logic in assessing the influence of ‘Panchagavya’ — an organic concoction in regulating the tomato yield. As an effort to evaluate the ‘real aura’ of ‘Panchagavya’ as a capable nutrient cum immune protective tonic for plants especially to Tomato, ‘grow bag’ study has been carried out both with seed treatment and foliar spray of Panchagavya on the organically raised tomato plants. The results of above study are used to derive 5 fuzzy logic membership functions by converting the crisp data into fuzzy data and to defuzzify for generating results for Tomato yield. The fuzzy results confirm that Young age, with optimum application of Panchagavya with high disease resistance, high plant height and more no of fruits set is perfect membership combination for optimum output of Tomato yield.

articleTitle: An implementation of image enhancement in satellite images using weighted average analysis
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: This paper proposes an implementation of image enhancement in satellite images using weighted average analysis. In this proposal the image acquired from the satellite is processed by Discrete Wavelet Transform (DWT) and further it is processed by two different approaches. First approach is the image optimization with adaptive thresholding and performs Inverse DWT and the another approach is Contrast Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalization (CLAHE) and performs Inverse DWT. Finally the attributes from the two IDWT are compared with its weighted average to obtain enhanced output image.

articleTitle: Affinity analysis for context-free grammars
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: Context-free grammars (CFGs) are a widely used class of formal grammars specially for the parsing of programming languages, files and data streams. Comparison of the structural information represented by different CFG will allow several additional applications in these contexts. Most current CFG comparison techniques focus on the determination of equivalence or non-equivalence rather than on determining the degree of similarity and so exploit only some of the capabilities of CFG. We present an algorithm for CFG Affinity Analysis using automatically and randomly generated test sentences. Our method provides an efficient and simple solution to a problem that has not yet received much attention. We intend to use this approach to develop a system for retrieval of structured data streams like music which can be effectively and sufficiently represented using CFG.

articleTitle: Sentimental analysis on web mining using statistical measures
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: Opinion mining or sentimental analysis plays important role in the data mining process. In the proposed method, opinions are classified using various statistical measures to provide ratings to help the sentimental analysis of big data. Experimental results demonstrate the efficiency of the proposed method to help in analysis of quality of product, marketers evaluation of success of a new product launched, determine which versions of a product or service are popular and identify demographics like or dislike of product features, etc.

articleTitle: Performance comparison of IDD controller with SSSC to that with TCPS for damping oscillations in AGC
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: In this paper, a new classical controller called as Integral Double Derivative Controller (IDD) in coordination with Static Synchronous Series Compensator (SSSC) and Thyristor controlled phase shifter (TCPS) is applied for the first time in automatic generation control (AGC) system. Comparative studies on the performance of IDD controller - SSSC and IDD controller - TCPS is carried out for load-frequency control (LFC) of two-area interconnected thermal reheat power system. The study is carried out considering appropriate generation rate constraints (GRC). A new meta-heuristic search algorithm called as Cuckoo Search (CS) is utilized for finding optimal designing parameters using Integral squared error technique (I.S.E). Critical examination of the dynamic responses of area frequency, tie power and generated power reveals that dynamic responses have improved further with the use of SSSC as compared to those with TCPS. It can be observed that the oscillations in area frequency, tie-power and generated power deviations have decreased to a considerable extent as compared to that of the system with TCPS. Further it is evident that IDD controller with SSSC gives far better performance than IDD with TCPS even in higher degree of perturbation in terms of oscillations and settling time.

articleTitle: Modeling of ZnO based HIT solar cells with comparative analysis
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: The modeling of solar cell structure is an important factor for improvement the efficiency of solar cell. The objective of this paper is to improve the efficiency of HIT solar cell. The HIT solar cell structure with a-Si and c-Si heterojunction is very common. The Structure is ITO/a-Si(n)/a-Si(i)/c-Si(p)//a-Si(p)/ITO. This work is concentrated on the modeling of the existing structures by replacing the emitter layer a-Si(n) with ZnO(n) to achieve the higher efficiency. The band gap, mobility of ZnO is much higher than amorphous silicon(a-Si), so ZnO is better than a-Si as an emitter layer. The proposed structure ITO/ZnO(n)/a-Si(i)/c-Si(p)/a-Si(p)/ITO is modeled and observed a significant solar cell efficiency of 25.54%. The HIT solar structure is developed in AFORS-HET Simulating tool. The comparison between the existing structure and the proposed structure is reported in this paper.

articleTitle: Scale invariant feature transform based copy-move forgery detection techniques on electronic images — A survey
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: The most widespread image tampering techniques is copy move forgery. The block based and key-point matching based methods have been proposed for the detection of copy-move image forgery. The key-point based method performs better than the block based methods in terms of computational efficiency, space complexity and it is robust against various geometric transformations such as scaling and rotation.
