publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: This paper contributes a detail implementation of digital modulation and detection of original data in LabVIEW. The objective of this work is to give an outline of the digital modulation techniques used in wireless communication systems. The move to digital modulation provides more information capacity, compatibility with digital data services, advanced data security, improved quality communications, and faster system availability. This article offering different modulation techniques such as On-off keying/Amplitude shift keying, Frequency shift Keying, Binary phase shift keying, Differential phase shift keying and Quadrature Phase Shift Keying.

Author Keywords: Frequency Shift Keying and Phase Shift Keying

articleTitle: Texture based back propagation neural networks for segmentation of arteriole and venule in fundus images
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: Segmentation of medical images plays an important role in the detection of abnormalities present in in it. In this paper, a combination of texture and Back Propagation Neural Networks is proposed for segmenting the arteries and veins present in the eye fundus images. To develop the proposed algorithm, the texture based back-propagation neural network (TBP-NN) is combined by a trained knowledge of textural properties for segmenting the arteriole and venule which can be used in early diabetic retinopathy (DR) detection. Our proposed algorithm is tested with a total of 200 fundus images, which has 100 early-stage DR and 100 normal images, which is used for further training. All retinal images were processed such that a priori knowledge in form of intensity values as features such as Energy. Homogeneity, Contrast and Correlation were automatically obtained. We compared our proposed algorithms efficiency with traditional BP-NN methods and support vector machine (SVM). The results show that the mean accuracy of a proposed algorithm which was higher than either that of the traditional BP-NN or that of the SVM classifier indicating that proposed algorithm could achieve a better segmentation results.

articleTitle: A case study: Energy audit at commercial and educational building
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: Now a day's everyone is going to generate the electric energy by conventional and non-conventional energy sources. But at the load side if we see the demand is also increasing. Hence we decided how we can do some work to reduce the existing energy demand. The energy audit is nothing but the inspection of energy flow and make some adjustments for energy savings. The main objective of energy audit is to reduce energy demand and which will be affect on energy bill. Energy audit gives an valuable information by an investigation about the energy requirements, utilization of energy, over consumption devices and the solutions regarding energy saving. Energy Audit is defined as “the verification, monitoring and analysis of use of energy including submission of technical report containing recommendations for improving energy efficiency with cost benefit analysis and an action plan to reduce energy consumption”. As per the Energy Conservation Act, 2001.

articleTitle: 1×1 Rectangular patch antenna
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: Microstrip patch antennas (MPA) is a commonly used in the last few years. Advantages of MSA are Ease of fabrication, Ease of design, Compactness of size, Ease of installation and size factor, Good aerodynamic profile and Low cost. But bandwidth is one of the major drawbacks. Researchers are trying to overcome this drawback of MSA. This paper present design of 1×1 microstrip rectangular patch antenna for 5.8GHz frequency using IE3D software.

articleTitle: PSO optimized PV-wind-battery system for satisfying the electrical needs of a remote area
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: With the growing interest in harnessing renewable energy resources because of their natural availability, clean and inexhaustible nature, a hybrid energy system employing renewable energy sources offers an attractive option to meet the electrical demands of remotely located locations. The main focus of this study is to find the optimal system configuration for satisfying the load demand of a cluster of villages located in a remote district of Uttarakhand, India using the available solar and wind resources in the region. A methodology based on particle swarm optimization (PSO) is adopted for optimal sizing of the system. Various system configurations are examined and compared among themselves considering total system cost and cost of energy (COE). According to the study results, the hybrid photovoltaic (PV)-wind-battery system appear cost effective as compared to standalone PV-battery and Wind-battery systems having lowest total system cost of Rs.7.72 lakh and COE of Rs. 18.47. Hence, the hybrid integration of PV-wind-battery system is most techno-economically viable option for the case study area.

articleTitle: Faults detection and identification of power transformer using wavelet-packet-transform
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: A standout amongst the most costly mechanical assembly in a power system network organizes is the Power Transformer, which needs a consistent checking of its wellbeing to such an extent that the system performs effectively. Present day control transformer is a standout amongst the most crucial gadgets of the electric power system and its insurance is basic. Hence, the assurance of energy transformers has taken a vital thought by the researchers. This paper subtle elements a one of a kind calculation receiving wavelet parcel change strategy which isolates the unique components between polarizing inrush and blame ebb and flow, of differential momentum in a differential security of a three stage transformer. The execution of the proposed procedure is checked under an assortment of blame conditions on a typical IEEE system is utilized to test and confirming the outcomes. In this manner the proposed technique is observed to be quick and exact.

articleTitle: Improving the spectrum aware mobility management in cognetive radio network
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: The system model conforms to the IEEE 802.22 standard, and the proposed two-step solution to the EE maximization problem satisfies users' minimum rate requirements and keeps the interference to the primary users in the neighboring areas below a specified threshold. TV white spaces are vacant frequencies made available for unlicensed use at locations where spectrum is not being used by licensed services, such as television broadcasting. The computational complexity of the resulting resource allocation protocol is the same as that of the least complex resource allocation protocol for orthogonal frequency division multiple access (OFDMA) downlinks Lack of articles dealing with cognitive radio EE in general is understandable, because cognitive radio EE maximization problem adds only one more constraint to the OFDMA EE maximization problem a per-carrier interference constraint. The focus of this paper is the frequency and power allocation that maximizes the bit/joule/hertz EE of orthogonal frequency division multiple access (OFDMA)-based transmissions from a cognitive base station operating in the TV white spaces.

articleTitle: Assessment of water parameters using Z-test for planning of aqua monitoring system using underwater sensor
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: Aquaculture planning and development is a very important process that will enhance and mentor the growth of the sector, while ensuring its long-term sustainability with environmentally and economically. In this proposed work, we have considered two rivers; Netravati and Sita which flows west coastal region of India and join Arabian Sea. These two rivers were studied with the planning of aquaculture and development carried out by deploying the underwater sensor nodes. Assessment of water parameter such as temperature, Salinity, Dissolved oxygen, Turbidity and pH values, and these parameters directly effect on the growth of aquaculture. For a time period the water parameter readings are stored and Z-test analysis applied for a hypothesis with respect to water parameter to evaluate the significant variation between two rivers. The analysis recommends the suitable place, fishes and guide an aquaculture development and planning process.

articleTitle: Intelligent data mining principles with privacy preserving procedures
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: The nearness of duplicate/copy records is a central data top notch circumstance in huge databases. To distinguish copies, substance choice otherwise called duplication recognition or record linkage is utilized as a piece of the data purging framework to decide documents that conceivably allude to the equivalent genuine world element. It wind up plainly mindful of the trickery with significantly less time of execution and in like manner without aggravating the dataset magnificent, techniques like dynamic barring and dynamic neighborhood are utilized. Imaginative arranged close-by system additionally alluded to as Advanced Progressive Sorted Neighborhood Method (APSNM) is utilized on this mannequin for finding or distinguishing the proliferation in a parallel technique. Dynamic closing off calculation takes a shot at enormous datasets where discovering duplication requires massive time. These calculations are utilized to build proliferation recognition approach. The effectivity may likewise be multiplied over the customary duplicate/copy recognition approach making utilization of this calculation.

articleTitle: Diminution of circulating current and voltage in-stabilization as a subset of energy management system for renewable micro grids
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: The benefaction of Renewable Energy Sources (RES) towards total installed capacity is increasing day-by-day. Though there is quantity of generation but scientific know how to manage these different sources at every instant of time is the need of the hour. Integration of several RES is a daunting task because each source possesses different electrical characteristics and they need to work in a coordinated manner. Problems arising due to interconnection are instability in voltage and inner circulation of current within micro grid. Such problems have been addressed by the use of inner loop controllers that is simple to implement and provides better performance as compared to other controllers such as conventional droop controller and distributed controller. Moreover, an extension based on the number of sources involved has been done. In this paper, hybrid system has been taken into consideration that involves Fuel Cell, Wind Energy, and Solar PV system. A comparison of proposed controller with other controllers and Validation of Energy Management System has been done in terms of voltage regulation and current deviation to evince the efficacy of the developed controller.

articleTitle: Processes incorporated in the extraction of IMF, EMD and speech signal analysis using Hilbert huang transform
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: New technologies collect and process data thus, it's an irrefutable necessity that our data processing, analysis tools and algorithms work more efficiently to keep up with the growing requirements. Hilbert Huang Transform is preferred because it uses empirical methods for data processing. Hilbert Huang Transform encompasses two important processes namely Empirical Mode Decomposition to generate Intrinsic Mode Function, and Hilbert Spectral Analysis to identify the local properties of the signal. Hilbert amplitude Spectrum and phase spectrum are studied which helps to isolate the instantaneous amplitude and phase of a signal. Marginal and normalized Hilbert Spectrum is also computed. It follows an empirical approach to solve the predicament caused by Bedrosian Theorem by using Amplitude Modulated wave and Frequency Modulated wave. Speech Signals are analyzed using Hilbert Huang Transform to generate Intrinsic Mode Functions.

articleTitle: Modified Cooley-Tukey algorithm for implementation of integrated serial FFT/IFFT processor in half-duplex OFDM systems
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDM) is one of the most spectrally efficient methods so far, which helps to achieve high data rates and also mitigates the severe problem of the multipath propagation and Inter Symbol Interference. Many IEEE 802.11 standards have adopted OFDM in their implementations for wireless systems. The heart of the OFDM is the digital implementation of Discrete Fourier Transform (DFT). DFT is efficiently implemented by FFT and IFFT algorithms. Radix-2 FFT Cooley-Tukey algorithms are quite popular for FFT and IFFT [1] implementations. The objective of this paper is to propose a modified Cooley-Tukey Radix-2 Single-path delay feedback algorithm which is capable of computation of both FFT and IFFT for serial inputs with the help of same hardware rather than separate for each. The combined FFT/IFFT processor can find its applications in half-duplex OFDM-based communication systems. Due to the efficiency and simplicity of the hardware, this implementation is attractive for low-cost applications.

articleTitle: Efficiency optimization of pump motor drive at steady-state condition
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: Traditionally, most of the major motor applications use variable frequency drive (VFD) to save electrical energy. The conventional VFDs better match speed to load but do not optimally minimize motor input power. Pumps are low dynamics applications and widely used. Significant energy savings can be obtained by implementing optimal flux control in partial load conditions. This paper proposes a new technique for efficient operation of induction motors used in pump application of an irrigation system. Excellent dynamic response in load transients as well as superior efficiency performance at steady-state are achieved, as compared to conventional rated flux operation. A total savings of .678 million units in electricity and $54,228 in energy cost is expected in one year on a 50 HP motor. The proposed method seems highly suitable for applications wherein load variations happen frequently, partial loading may occur for prolonged duration and speed is not a critical issue.

articleTitle: Classification of lung nodules with feature extraction using CT scan images
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: OBJECTIVE: The main aim is to differentiate the various types of lung nodules using the SVM classifier. By identifying the lung nodules, the cause of lung cancer can be avoided. METHODOLOGY: The major contributions in this system are (i) Patch based division, to partition the original images (ii) Feature extraction stage, to extract feature information (iii) Classification stage, to classify the four types of lung nodules with the help of SVM classifier with pLSA. FINDINGS: This system has an improvement with the Local Tetra Pattern (LTrP) to provide more feature information. This pattern extracts feature information from more than two direction to give accurate results. IMPROVEMENT: This system can be improved with different classifier to achieve accurate classification.

articleTitle: Design of residential photovoltaic power system using current-fed push-pull front end converter
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: These paper showes, push-pull converter along with soft-switching current-fed front end converter. Renewable energy is gaining importance in residential as well as industrial application. Generally there are two mechanism in manufacturing of PV panel, parallel-connected configuration and series-connected configuration. Looking at the safety issue in this paper, series-connected configuration is used. Initially Push-pull converter converts and step-up DC/DC voltage and after this stage, inverter inverts DC/AC. Active clamping circuit is used to overcome the effect of voltage overshoot. Effect of voltage spike is reduced by using Zero-current switching of primary devices and zero-voltage switching of secondary devices. Wide variation in voltage is maintained by Soft-switching. To check the result a 250W simulation is proposed.

articleTitle: Image processing and machine learning applied for condition monitoring of 11-kV power distribution line insulators using curvelet and LTP features
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: Due to massive growth in the consumption of power, the damaged insulators on the electric poles prompt the breakage of the power supply which leads to considerable loss occurring for the power industry and regular monitoring is required. So, pictures of the poles can be taken, send them to the processing unit and image processing techniques can be applied to classify the insulator health condition into healthy or risky and necessary action can be taken by the maintenance personnel. The insulator images are extracted from the acquired pole image input and then individual insulator's statistical features are obtained based on Curvelet transform based statistical features and Local Ternary Pattern (LTP) histograms. The obtained features of insulator images are given to Support Vector Machines classifier to determine the health condition of an insulator and the experiment results are validated.

articleTitle: Iris biometric security using watermarking and visual cryptography
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: This paper presents a novel security architecture which protects the iris using watermarking and visual cryptography techniques. The iris region is protected using watermarking technique where we are using DCT to embedd the watermarked text image into the iris image in the low frequency band. After performing watermarking, the watermarked image is furthur processed to generate a template using Daugmans method and Gabor filter. The generated template is then gone through another security protection scheme using visual cryptography. Here the template is divided into two shares where one is present with the user and other in the data base. This is the enrollment module. Now for the Authentication module the user share and the data base share are overlapped and then the template is generated. Now the generated template is matched with the template which was already generated using Daugmans method. If both the templates are matched authentication is provided otherwise the person is unauthenticated. This paper is implemented using Matlab.

articleTitle: Risk assessment of wireless communication network for PMUs
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: The phasor measurement unit (PMU) revolutionized the real time monitoring of power system and has emerged as the edifice of the wide area measurement system (WAMS). Communication system plays an imperative role in the efficacious implementation of the WAMS. Wireless technology and fiber optic cables are the viable synchrophasor communication technology. This paper presents the risk assessment of wireless communication network for PMUs and their subsequent optimum placement for risk minimization. Risk assessment for the power grid of Odisha, India is presented as a case study.

articleTitle: Design and development of Raspberry Pi based system for prepaid electricity meter
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: In this paper proposes, Raspberry Pi Processor based electricity billing system for above and below poverty is developed of household in real-time. Now a days the electricity board on behalf of Government, releases a benefits for the below and above poverty peoples in India especially. This work is more benefits of Government in India. The Aadhar card is based in customer is either above or below poverty and to improve the loss of government in Electricity billing system using Raspberry Pi Processor. The customer is consuming the units by electricity board, if the low balance to indicate wrong and automatically cut-off the load. This experimental setup is successfully complete using Qt software in research Laboratory setup by the Department of Electronics, Sri Krishnadevaraya University, Ananthapuramu.

articleTitle: Grid integrated solar photovoltaic system with static compensator
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: Renewable energy sources are getting more and more widespread mainly due to the fact that they are environmentally friendly. The reduced prices of Photovoltaic (PV) system components and technological developments of power electronics have also motivated the harnessing of renewable energy. The interconnection of renewable energy sources are incorporated using power electronics converters, with the aim of improving power quality at the point of common coupling (PCC). This study presents a STATCOM which is used as: a) a load reactive power compensator, b) an interface unit between the grid and renewable energy source, and c) as an effective method for real power exchange between load, grid and renewable energy source. A controller unit used for the STATCOM based on modified Icosφ algorithm by which reactive power compensation and power factor correction is done and also real power support is provided by renewable energy source through STATCOM. In this study a solar PV system is designed for 29 KW<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">p</sub> and it is integrated with grid using STATCOM to supply partial active power of 50 kW and full reactive power of 30kVAr of load. Results show that the use of active power from solar PV system and reactive power compensation of STATCOM reduces demand of load on the grid, which in turn increase the load capacity of source.

articleTitle: Summarization using mapreduce framework based big data and hybrid algorithm (HMM and DBSCAN)
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: With the adventure of the internet there is vast increase in the storage of information. Almost all the information exists in digital form which reduces lots of the paper work and increases ease of storage. Searching relevant information in collection of documents is a tedious task. The solution comes in picture for this problem is automatic text summarization. In this paper, abstract summary generation of large amount of documents for big data is proposed which will consider user input as topic. The proposed system is designed using DBSCAN algorithm which works with MapReduce framework for clustering and Hidden Markov Model for summarization. The summarization process is performed in three main stages and provides a modular implementation of large numbre of documents for summarization. The proposed method follows preprocessing step in which documents are scanned with similarity and various machine learning technique are applied. The result of applying clustering enhances the summarizer system to collect exact words rather than copying redundant words. Topic based abstract summarization from big data is challenging task particularly when there are multiple documents with same or different content. Hadoop with its programming techniques can provide better ways of generating summary and it also enhances the complexity of summarization process using distributed computing.

articleTitle: Cooperative bait detection scheme in MANETs
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: MANET plays a very crucial role in todays communication system where most of the communicating devices are mobile. As MANET has no fixed infrastructure they are prone to malicious node attacks. In this paper we are concentrating on the effects of delay, throughput, PDR (packet delivery ratio), on the various protocols like CBDS, Dynamic Source Routing and CBDS with 85 and 95 percent threshold depending on the change in the number of nodes. Here it is noted that in PDR, CBDS is the best while in delay DSR is the best and in dropping ratio CBDS with 85 percent threshold is the weakest. In throughput and energy DSR is weak while in case of jitter all are similar. This paper also gives insight on the PDR for different protocols depending on malicious node ratio, here DSR is a little backward. The collaboration of CBDS along with Certificate Authority by calculating Trust Vector (TV) has overcome the drawback of previous system like delay and routing overhead.

articleTitle: Integration of solar photovoltaic power, battery and DC-DC converter for waste water treatment
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: In this study, soak liquor generated from leather processing was treated by electro chemical oxidation using battery-integrated solar photovoltaic system (BI-SPV) as power source. The influence of operating parameter such as current density, pH and contact time on Chemical Oxygen Demand (COD) removal was studied. The objective of the battery-integrated solar photovoltaic system was to reduce the electrical energy consumption and store the energy in the battery and supply continuously without any interruption for the electro oxidation process. A kinetic model was developed for the treatment of soak liquor using BI-SPV system. The results revealed that the treatment of soaked liquor could be effectively treated at low cost by this eco-friendly BI-SPV system.

articleTitle: Photovoltaic based proportional resonant controlled buck boost converter with coupled inductor
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: Buck Boost Converter with Coupled Inductor (BBCCI) can be to used match the DC input source voltage with the load voltage. The modeling and control of BBCCI becomes an important issue. This work deals with modeling and simulation of BBCCI system with proportional resonant (PR) controller. The objective of this work is to improve dynamic response of closed loop BBCCI system using PR controller. The closed loop controlled BBCCI systems with PI and PR controllers are modeled, simulated and the results are analyzed. The results indicate that the dynamic response is improved using PR controller. The proposed system has advantages like reduced THD, low settling time and steady state error. The hardware for BBCCI is tested and experimental results are compared with the simulation results.

Author Keywords: Buck Boost Converter with Coupled Inductor (BBCCI)

articleTitle: Controlling of voltage sag in AC distribution system by using fuzzy logic controller
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: Power quality is the major foremost uncertainties in the current scenario. It has become imperative, particularly, with the primer of refined devices, their response to the power supply variations that causes failure of equipment. Major problem discussed here is voltage swell and voltage sag. Dynamic Voltage Restorer (DVR), is the commonly used efficient and operative power device. It is used in transmission and distribution grids. It has several advantages that include quick response time, compact in size, and less cost. It supplies or injects voltage to the power system thereby providing a comprehensive solution to voltage sag. This paper discusses about simulation and modeling of DVR. In this paper Discrete PWM technique and PI controller was used as switching technique.

articleTitle: Palmprint identification using radial basis probabilistic neural network
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: In this paper, we present an effective texture based approach for palmprint recognition. It has three major steps. First, region of interest (ROI) is extracted from the hand image. Then, features are extracted in the processing stage from the palmprint texture using discrete cosine transform (DCT). High frequency coefficients located at the lower right corner of the DCT matrix are omitted considering them as redundant features, thus obtaining dimension reduction. Finally, radial basis probabilistic neural network (RBPNN) is used for classification. It is comparatively a newer method for image classification, comprising features of radial basis function network (RBFN) and probabilistic neural network (PNN). The system is then compared with different ANN classifiers to justify its viability. Average recognition rate of 99.75% demonstrate the efficiency and validity of the method. It's faster in operation, thus making it suitable for online identification as well.

articleTitle: Generation of electricity by using speed breakers
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: Electricity is generated by replacing the usual speed breakers with some simple mechanism. As vehicles pass over the speed breakers, rack and pinion mechanism works and with the help of high tension springs in turn generate electricity. This method is an effective way to produce electricity as the number of vehicles is ever increasing. It can be effectively placed near toll plazas, parking lots and other locations where density of vehicles is very high. A rack and pinion, spring assembly mechanism is provided which transfer the motion to a DC motor/generator for electricity generation. This method provides a cost effective way to generate electricity from the mechanical energy of dynamic vehicles on roads.

articleTitle: Modal analysis of a 6 D.O.F seismic simulator
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: Buildings built these days are made earthquake resistant. To test the efficiency of the buildings to withstand the seismic vibrations, a scaled model (or sometimes 1:1 prototype) is placed over a table called as `shake table'. This shake table has 6 degrees of freedom (DOF) and motions or vibrations are imparted to this table using actuators to test the earthquake resistance of the building. The risk is that if the natural frequency of the shake table matches with the imparted frequency, there will be a resonance and the shake table will fail. To ensure that the natural frequency of the shake table is not within the range of frequency of earthquake vibration, modal analysis is performed. In this paper, a methodology is proposed how to do the modal analysis of a 6 DOF parallel manipulator based on RPRS topology which is used as a shake table. An FFT analysis is also performed to determine the predominant frequency of the imparted earthquake data on the shale table.

articleTitle: A real-time approach using feed forward neural network for a 5 DOF robot manipulator
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: This paper displays a procedure for solving the inverse kinematics problem utilizing neural networks in realtime application. The inverse kinematics problem for a robotic manipulator is acquired for the required manipulator joint values for a given desired end point position and orientation. The proposed strategy yields various and exact arrangements and it is suitable for real-time applications. The Conclusive simulation shows that, by utilizing this new calculating algorithm, it can give a precise inverse kinematics solution quick and has higher efficiency. Aside from these, when utilizing as a part of practice, it additionally mirrors a flawless execution.

articleTitle: Implementation of fused floating point four term dot product unit using modified booth algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: This paper mainly presents about the implementation of fused floating point four term dot product unit using modified booth algorithm. Dot product is one of the most basic algorithm used in signal processing of natural data such as image, audio, video and sound. Dot product is one of the most commonly used mathematical operations in 3D graphics, digital signal processing and statistical applications. Floating point is the one of the best way to represent real numbers in binary format. In previous researches process the fused floating point four term dot product unit dadda multiplier are used as multiplier tree and kogg stone adder are used addition with an increase in area and power consumption. A few changes can be brought to this work which can reduce the area and power. The proposed method uses modified booth algorithm and brent kung adder. On implementing the present method there will be an effective reduction in area and power.

Author Keywords: Brent Kung adder and Wallace multiplier

articleTitle: Object-oriented method for modeling six-degree-of-freedom simulation system of aerocraft
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: In order to improve the efficiency, reliability, maintenance ability and expansibility of modeling, the object-oriented method for modeling the 6-DOF (six-degree-of-freedom) simulation system of aero craft is proposed in this paper. UML (Unified Modeling Language) is adopted to model the system. Firstly, from users' view, we analyzed the basic requirements of the simulation system and modeled it by use case diagram. Secondly, from the view of system realization the classes and their relationships are designed. The main events and activities were modeled by sequence diagram simultaneously. Finally, taking the hardware realization into account we established deployment diagram of the system. The simulation result of the trajectory shaping guidance shows that the time consuming of simulation is decreased while guaranteeing the identical of the result. At the same time, the portability, security, reusability, maintainability and modeling efficiency of the simulation system is upgraded.

Author Keywords: six degree of freedom of missile

articleTitle: Analysis of 3 phase induction motor in different speed reference frame coordinates
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: This paper shows the modeling of 3 phase induction motor. It gives the impact of load modeling in induction motor. The main objective is to analyze the different features of the induction motor under different reference frame coordinate. The paper defines the different way for the modeling of induction motor using (d-q), (D-Q) and (α, β) coordinate system.

articleTitle: Timing convergence techniques in digital VLSI designs
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: Primary goal of every design is to improve performance of the system. In digital designs increase in frequency is very important with each versions of design. As frequency increases number of negative paths in a circuit will become more, after static timing analysis. Techniques for making negative margin paths to positive margin are explained here. Through cell resizing, placement optimization, clock tuning and routing optimization timing closure can be achieved.

articleTitle: Design and analysis of a multiband antenna with L-strips for cellular phone application
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: The updating technology in mobile devices requires multiple resonant frequencies for various applications in a single antenna. Cellular devices are widely using GSM, DCS, PCS, UMTS, Bluetooth and WiMAX technologies. The aim of this paper is to integrate all these applications in a single antenna that covered in a triband operation. To achieve this, asymmetrical L-Strips as slot radiators and defected ground plane are used. The -6dB impedance bandwidth of 111 MHz (849-960 MHz), 960MHz (1.58-2.54 GHz), 150MHz (5.70-5.85 GHz), which covers entire bands of the all the applications. The antenna model is simulated and analyzed in Ansoft HFSS13 software.

articleTitle: Soft swichting Dc-Dc converter with full Zvs range application
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: In this Project, we analyzed a switched resonant power converter for solar power applications. This circuit topology integrates a switched resonant Converter with zero-voltage switching (ZVS). Resonant converters are extensively utilized in the application of solar power generation systems. The basic requirements of resonant converters are their small size and high efficiency. A high switching frequency is required to achieve small size. To solve the problems due to the switching losses, some soft-switching approaches must be used at high switching frequencies such as Zero-voltage switching (ZVS). High frequency switching reduces the transformer size and filter size. But increase the switching losses. Soft switching is used to reduce the switching losses with help of LC component.

articleTitle: Improved probability based fuzzy C-means and active contour using brain tumor images
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: In the medical image process, electronic image segmentation forms into hugely a fundamental for tumor growth detection. In mutual Segmentation techniques have need of more point in time as well as information. Nonetheless, these drawbacks had conquered as a result of automatic segmentation still there requirements to develop a lot of applicable techniques for medical image segmentation. Accordingly, this paper suggests an innovative image segmentation technique based totally on Improved description of Probability based Fuzzy C-Means(IPFCM) in addition to Active Contour Segmentation(AC). These characteristics of PFCM and AC have been utilized in this paper for improving image segmentation. The proposed IPFCM-AC based image segmentation is compared with FCM, TFCM, and PFCM. For this reason, the result used to made assessment with the various performance measures as Accuracy, Mean absolute error, Dice Overlap, Jaccard Index, Jaccard Distance, MSE, RMSE, and PSNR and Boundary Displacement Error. These consequences have been considerably used for evaluation by means of the ground truth of every processed image and its results are compared as well as analysed.

Author Keywords: Probability based fuzzy C-Means Image Segmentation

articleTitle: Development of prototype model of DC-DC bi-directional converter
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: This paper presents development of prototype model of DC-DC bidirectional converter. Proposed work uses microcontroller for control of an isolated bi-directional DC-DC converter which is designed for study purpose and the principle can be used to design the same circuit for automotive application. Here power flow is controlled from a high voltage end to the low voltage end in buck mode operation (step-down mode) and from low voltage end to high voltage end in boost mode operation (step-up mode). To control the power flow in buck mode a phase shift full bridge rectifier circuit on HV side is used as inverter where as to control the power flow in boost mode a push pull convert circuit is used. An active clamp circuit is designed to limit transient voltage spikes on LV side during buck mode of operation. The proposed method is modeled and its performance is studied with MATLAB software. The simulation is done using MATLAB/SIMULINK and the desired results are obtained. Experimental results for system operation have been verified on a 16W system.

articleTitle: Using conformal mapping in developing a novel optimal obstacle-avoidance trajectory-planning for a flying robot
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: In this work, a new systematic method is proposed to enhance the process of optimum trajectory planning in Terrain / Obstacle Avoidance Flights (TOAF) with use of conformal mappings as a facilitator of the effect of the flight altitude restriction on the route selection. The use of Conformal Mapping concept could help to transform a constrained trajectory planning problem, in presence of obstacles or any height constraint, into a simple pseudo obstacle-free optimal trajectory-planning problem. Suitable case studies show that the proposed approach is more consistent with basic flight concepts as well as real world applications. Applicability of the introduced approach is demonstrated by solving a 2-D obstacle-avoidance motion using direct pseudo-spectral method.

articleTitle: Web forum crawling using text-based filters
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: Forum websites contain very valuable information about frequently occurred problems in any subject. The good thing about these forums is, it is organized in a very proper format so that people can navigate easily to their expected discussion page. Now a days search engines are becoming very specific for different types of websites. So, they are making special crawlers for different types of websites to crawl exact information from raw html code. The research on forum crawlers is increased since last few years. But the main challenge in forum crawlers is finding similarity between URLs from different forum sites. This paper focuses on crawling forum URLs and classifying them as Entry, Index, Thread and Page Flipping URLs.

articleTitle: Review of cooperative spectrum sensing methods for optimization of energy and delay
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: Today growth of wireless applications and number of users is exponential and with fact of finite availability of spectrum; spectrum scarcity, congestion, loss of signal quality are important issues in wireless communication. Spectrum Sensing and secondary use of spectrum is a upcoming solution for spectrum scarcity, but Spectrum Sensing creates burden on energy consumption as well as time limits of wireless nodes. This paper addresses about factors affecting on Cooperative Spectrum Sensing and review of techniques used to optimize delay and energy consumption.

articleTitle: FPGA based sliding mode control of PMSM for torque ripple reduction
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: This work illustrates a simple and efficient torque ripple reduction method for Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motors. In this technique, the Sliding Mode controller will be used as a tracking controller. The control objective is to track a reference speed with the actual speed of rotor. In order to achieve the desired speed, the phase voltage must be varied as a function of rotor angular displacement. The angular speed of the synchronous motor depends on the frequency of the voltage applied to the stator windings. This neccesitates the measurement of angular displacement of the motor. The error signal between the reference and actual speeds represents the sliding surface s. The sliding mode controller is derived from the d-q variables and is based on Lyapunov's stability concept. Moreover with the addition of an observer to estimate the applied load torque, it can compensate for load torque disturbances. Hence the torque ripples get reduced in Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor. The results obtained in Sliding Mode Control is compared with the conventional Direct Torque Control. The Direct Torque Control and Sliding Mode Control are simulated in Matlab/Simulink environment. The simulation results validate the effectiveness of Sliding Mode Control over Direct Torque Control. Hardware implementation of Sliding Mode Control is done on a prototype motor of 5V using Xilinx FPGA Spartan 3AN and ISE Design Suite 14.5.

articleTitle: Power quality improvement in distribution system using hybrid AC/DC configuration
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: Most of the electric equipment used in low voltage distribution systems have a single phase rectifier at the front end of their internal circuits to convert the alternating current (ac) supply into direct current (dc). If these equipment can directly be powered by a suitable dc supply, overall efficiency can be improved and harmonics can be reduced. In this paper the performance of a hybrid distribution system which accommodates both ac and dc loads is analyzed. A harmonic power recovery scheme is incorporated into the network to recover the harmonic power which is usually wasted in the primary delta winding of distribution transformer. The effectiveness of the system is validated by simulation on SIMULINK/MATLAB platform.

articleTitle: Implementation of a joint power harvesting and communication technology on a smartphone's 3.5mm audio interface
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: With the popularization of smartphones, various smartphone-centric applications have emerged, which use a smartphone in conjunction with microcontrollers and sensors for data acquisition, processing, display, communication, and storage. Because smartphones do not have a universal data interface, many applications use the 3.5mm audio interface for data communications so that they can work with various types of smartphones, but the problem on the power supply is unsolved. In this paper, we have combined the Frequency Shift Keying (FSK) modulation scheme with AudioTrack Streaming mode into an app to establish joint data and power transmission on both left and right audio channels so that the smartphone can provide up to 36.3mW power and 1.6kbps data rate to the microcontroller. Furthermore, we have implemented digital data filter, power detector, timing-error detector/corrector and differential Manchester coder and decoder in the same app and achieved up to 7.35kbps data rate from the microcontroller to the smartphone.

articleTitle: A survey on senegalese corporate information and technology infrastructure transformation on cloud services: The resilience of senegalese companies
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: The recent computer attacks from new types of computer viruses like Petya in June 2017 and the outbreak of WannaCry in May 2017, which exploit vulnerabilities in popular operating systems, have paralyzed many large companies in the world, within twenty-four hours. Some companies were forced to stop their activities for several hours or even days, which shows their vulnerability as far as their ability to protect themselves is concerned, or their ability to continue their activities in case of disasters. Senegalese companies, even if they have not been victims, face enormous risks with outdated infrastructures and a lack of strategic planning to control major risks.

articleTitle: Harmonic stability assessment for PV-Fed Multi paralleled 1-Ø inverters connected to grid
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: The main objective of this work is to analyze and investigation on Harmonic Stability Assessment for PV Fed Multi paralleled 1-Ø Inverters connected to Grid is checked by using the Impedance based Stability Criterion (IBSC), The causes for Harmonically stabilized/destabilize the inverter by varying grid impedance under Dynamic consideration of load and it is point out and Analysed by the impedance-based stability criterion. Beyond that the case studies of Variable grid impedance are given and its Time domain simulation results are provided in the MATLAB-Simulink area in broad nature when the Dynamic consideration of PV fed Multi paralleled inverters connected to grid. Finally, the harmonic commerce problems are occurred in current power system and it can be assessed by the impedance-based stability criterion analysis through shoot those problems.

articleTitle: Proposition and performance analysis of a DC/DC boost converter
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: A DC/DC boost converter is designed in this paper, and its performance is analyzed subsequently. The scenario of a hybrid energy plant is considered. Two power sources are integrated by the boost converter to provide a higher voltage in the DC bus. In simulation, two DC cells are used as power source. Each of the DC cells is driven by a switching circuit to form an individual boost cell. Orcad Capture 9.2 is used as simulator with a computer having Core-i3 processor. Circuit parameters like inductance, pulse voltage frequency and duty cycle of the switching circuits etc. were varied to observe their effect on efficiency. Finally MATLAB is used to observe the efficiency in a 3D plot with respect to the change of duty cycle and frequency of the pulse voltages.

articleTitle: Performance improvement of distribution system using dynamic evolution controller for boost converter in PV
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: Photovoltaic which is intermittent in nature has to be made constant at the consumer side irrespective of the change in input or load. Often the controller that is used for boosting the voltage may have an initial shoot which may not be acceptable by all the devices. In this paper the performance of Dynamic Evolution controller (DEC) in boost converter for changes in insolation of PV and load has been investigated. It is found that the rapid and stable response nature of DEC with faster settling time is superior to other conventional controllers. The major benefit is that, during changes in the solar irradiation the DEC accordingly varies the duty cycle of the gate pulse and the variation in input voltage is compensated in addition to boosting and regulating the converter output voltage, which makes it suitable in highly nonlinear and variable PV systems. Simulation results show the effectiveness of DEC in reducing the shoot while keeping the equipment and user's satisfaction.

articleTitle: Increasing PV penetration level in smartgrid system scenario by enhancement of reactive power support using fuzzy logic controller
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: In the distributed generation environment, existing standard system enforce limits on the deductible feeder voltage variation. These agreements must limit the power incursion level. If the incursion level increases it leads to increased or decreased feeder voltage and causes reverse current flow in the feeder. In order to intense this problem we need reactive power support to the feeder. By the use of following accepted customs and proprieties capacitor or inductor banks we cannot achieve full range of voltage control (voltage regulation). This paper proposes a novel scheme containing fuzzy logic controller(FLC), and, auxiliary voltage source converter (VSC) that enables smooth trailing of reactive power according to the load requirement. The proposed system constellation can handily retrofitted into the existing system within photovoltaic station itself and reliving the utility from additional voltage support burden. This in turn increases the photovoltaic incursion level in the feeder line. The corresponding designing, studyas well asthe control design strategy, and the MATLAB Simulation results are discussed.

articleTitle: Fault analysis of diode clamped inverter based induction motor drive
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: In this article Fault analysis in 3 level and 5 level inverter to drive Induction motor is presented. Induction motors are widely used in industrial applications for their intrinsic ruggedness and reduced cost. Recently, the use of adjustable speed drives has spread in many applications. Most of the industrials motors are used today are in fact induction motors. Induction motors have been used in the past mainly in applications requiring a constant speed because conventional methods of their speed control have either been expensive or highly inefficient. Multilevel inverters have a high number of switching states so that the output voltage is stepped in smaller increments. This allows mitigation of the harmonics at low switching frequencies thereby reducing switching losses. Almost 38% of faults in industrial loads like variable speed ac drive. IGBT's are used in almost all converters as power handling capability is high. It is estimated that among all types of faults in variable speed ac drives in industry, 10 μs. The performance of the system is analyzed by adopting MATLAB/SIMULINK software.

articleTitle: Sign language recognition of invariant features based on multiclass support vector machine with beam ECOC optimization
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: This paper presents a recognition system for understanding the American Sign Language using Support Vector Machine (SVM) and Error Correcting Output Codes (ECOC). In the pre-processing stage, invariant local features were extracted to develop the recognition system using multi-class support vector machine. The binary classifier of SVM employed with ECOC framework to deal multi-class problems. In ECOC, the encoding matrix was designed using various coding strategy such as one versus one, one versus all and random matrix. The data has trained based on coding matrix with set of dichotomizes independently and classify the data using loss-based decoding method to obtain efficient accuracy. In this paper, performance of recognition rate has been improved by updating given ECOC matrix from the original matrix using beam ECOC optimization. By employing beam ECOC, classification accuracy was increased from 70 to 80% than the state-of-art coding strategy.

articleTitle: 2-DOF PID controller based load frequency control of a hydro-thermal power system
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: In the proposed work, the key focus has been made on the application of an optimal 2-DOF PID controller in a two area system consisting of a thermal unit and a hydro unit in each area with the gains tuned with the help of Gravitational Search Algorithm (GSA). The supremacy of the system is tested by observing the dynamic performance of the system under a step load perturbation of 0.01 p.u. and sudden load changes. The optimum gains of the controller are obtained with the consideration of Integral Time Absolute Error (ITAE) as the objective function. The results thereby obtained are compared with the previos journal results of traditional PID controller and the supremacy is verified. The values of the performance indices like settling time, maximum overshoot, minimum undershoot for the proposed 2-DOF PID controller are studied and compared with the PID controller in order to establish the robustness of the proposed system.

articleTitle: Fundamental reference signal generation for shunt active filter for harmonic and reactive power mitigation using Xilinx system generator
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: This paper proposes the design of the controller using a Xilinx system generator for Shunt active filter (SAF) to alleviate harmonics and reactive power supply mains. This control algorithm evolved from elemental synchronous reference frame engenders the fundamental reference signal from the load current with a phase shift of zero angle. The proposed algorithm is tested in harmonic load and reactive load and it is verified by implementing the model in MATLAB Xilinx system generator. The comparison study was carried out for the proposed algorithm and conventional algorithm and the results are validated through control of hardware circuit using the FPGA processor.

articleTitle: Performance improvement of DVR by control of reduced-rating with a battery energy storage system
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: Voltage injection methods for DVRs (Dynamic Voltage Restorers) and operating modes are resolved in this paper. Using fuzzy logic control DVR with dc link & with BESS systems are operated. Power quality problems mainly harmonic distortion, voltage swell & sag are decreased with DVR using Synchronous Reference Theory (SRF theory) with the help of fuzzificaton waveforms are observed.

articleTitle: A low power high efficiency BPSK transceiver using level converter for communication applications
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: Transreceivers designed using single supply threshold voltage consists of transmitter section and receiver section where the sub systems of the design use same supply voltage whereas some sub systems may not require the same power requirements for the design. Instead the paper focuses on designing a multi vth level Converter based Transreceiver where a Level converter converts Low to High or High to Low Voltage to different sub systems of the design. In this paper, design of a Dual-Vdd and multi threshold Level converter based Transreceiver using Single Clocking methodology is analyzed with respect its operation then building and testing using Cadence Tools. In realization, first discuss the architecture and the implementation issues. Then, the coding process is simulated and verified by Cadence Tools.

articleTitle: MEMS based optical phase modulator using directional coupler
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: Continuous growing demand of real time computing originate frequent need of much faster processors than those are already available. There is a prompt evolution of new optical communication related application and components to fulfill these requirements. The attempt of combining these two methods leads to the generation of optoelectronic devices. The new device is MEMS based nanoscale silicon on insulator photo activated modulator using directional coupler. The design, simulation & characterization of an optoelectronic device based on Si which is capable of speeding up the processing capabilities have been presented in this paper. In this control command is sent optically and the nature of data flow is electronic. Faster operation rates are expected with the device. This optical device can serve as a building block of optical data processing while breaking through the way to all optic processors based on Si chips.

articleTitle: Adaptive 360 degree image recognition approach to empower visually impaired
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: The visually impaired, in their daily lives face innumerable challenges. Amongst which, the ability to independently navigate and perform daily tasks are the most highly affected activities. This approach is based on the abilities of utilizing visual feeds from cameras, image processing and machine learning to detect, identify and inform the user about objects in front or behind them. Empowering the visually impaired for independent navigation, along with the ability to process daily tasks with audio assistance on multiple object detection and identification in an outdoor and indoor setting.

articleTitle: An overview study of various re-coloring and wavelength adjustment algorithm for color vision deficient individuals
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: Color Blindness which can be also referred as Color Vision Deficiency (CVD) is one of the biggest scaling defect in humans which is still under the research for its accurate detection and cure measures & strategies. Color Blindness is the decreased ability to sight the distinctive colors instantly under normal lighting conditions. There are approximately 250 million individuals who suffer from Color Blindness. So it is need of an hour to understand all the important aspects of the Problem CVD and take the necessary measures to help the People who are knowingly or unknowingly suffering from CVD. In this paper we are going to put light on how exactly color blindness is genetically transferred to children, types in color vision deficiency i.e. Anomalous Trichromacy (protanomaly, deuteranomaly, tritanomaly), Monochromacy and how exactly person sees the normal image under respective CVD and finally put light on few algorithms and strategies which with the help of re-coloring and wavelength shifting actually help the color vision deficient to view and sight all the colors of the actual image distinctively.

articleTitle: Learning telecommunication engineering standards: A case study
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: The telecommunication sector is affected by very quick changes and developments, especially for mobile technologies. The finalization of technical standards is crucial for guaranteeing a common language for technical and business interactions among all stakeholders. Standards are also crucial from a commercial point of view in terms of powerful market launch of a device, equipment, system or service in telecommunication sector. Students of technical degrees in telecommunication are strongly motivated for a deep analysis of involved standards. The author presents a case study of the importance of standards in education. The paper presents results of two different surveys conducted among the students. The first survey is performed at the end of the course, the second one after two years among the same ex-students, become young professionals. The surveys evidence the importance of knowing technical standard as a key part for the actual working activities and the actual employer.

articleTitle: An efficient PAPR analysis of OFDMA for cellular communications
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: Orthogonal frequency division multiple access (OFDMA) has bright era of wireless communication system. An OFDM system is combined with multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) in order to increase the diversity gain and system capacity over the time variant frequency-selective channels. However major drawback of MIMO-OFDM high peak-to-average power ratio (PAPR). The Probabilistic techniques: SLM scheme and PTS are the most popular PAPR reduction techniques. A major disadvantage of the SLM scheme is the transmission of the Side Information (SI) bits to enable the receiver to recover the transmitted data. A new version i.e. directed PTS whose performance is compared with the directed SLM. This work deals with reduction of PAPR and other performance metrics like Bit Error Rate (BER), Probability detection of SI bits and Bandwidth degradation.

articleTitle: Control of remotely operated vehicle using fractional order controller
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: Remotely Operated Vehicles have been emerged as a reliable and fast acting devices in exploring underwater resources over the last few decades. This has inspired the researchers to develop and implement new control techniques to overcome challenges in external disturbances and to improve the response of system. The mathematical modeling of ROV is highly nonlinear and complex in nature. To simplify, these equations a reduced order decoupled system is considered in each plane. This paper presents the control of ROV's depth and steering using Fractional order sliding mode control and is compared with classical sliding mode control.

articleTitle: Effect of flexure hinge geometry on central deflection of piezo actuated diaphragm for micropump
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: This paper discusses the effect of flexure hinge geometry on piezo actuated diaphragms for the micropump application. Use of flexure hinges in the diaphragm is one of the approaches to increase the diaphragm central deflection, selection of proper flexure hinges for out-of-plane application is important. COMSOL analysis is used to study the effect of flexure hinge geometry on the central deflection and stress distribution in the diaphragm. Rectangle hinge, circular cut-out hinge and corner fillet flexure hinges were chosen with a constant width of 1.5mm and 2mm length. In the present investigation, the central deflection of the diaphragm with different flexure hinges are studied and compared with a plane diaphragm with respect to actuating voltage. The simulation result shows that the maximum deflection is obtained from circular cut-out flexure diaphragm i.e. 9.35μm. Whereas stress distribution in circular flexure hinge diaphragm is more compared to rectangular flexure hinge diaphragm, which may lead to failure. Therefore rectangular flexure diaphragm has the advantage of minimum stress concentration with higher deflection compared to corner fillet and circular flexure. The deflection of rectangle flexure hinge diaphragm is 8.65μm which is 64% more compared to plane diaphragm.

articleTitle: An independent AC-DC converter operating on buck and buck-boost topology for low power harvesting
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: Independent powered devices harvest the ambient energies by micro generators and can perform their Operations without any continuous external power supply. Many types of micro-generators, used in the self-powered devices, are reported in the literature for harvesting different forms of ambient energies. Minimum voltage generators requires higher efficiency which can be obtained by direct conversion of low ac input voltage to required high voltage dc output at higher efficiency.ac-dc bridge converters may not be of practical use for operation of micro generators. This paper presents a novel ac-dc converter topology for low power harvesting where a boost converter is operated in positive half cycle and a buck-boost converter is operated in negative half cycle. For independent operation a self-starting circuit is proposed and power parameters and duty cycle are used to operate and control the converter where detailed loss calculation of converter is carried out. Experimental results are also presented along with simulation Design guidelines are presented for selecting the converter component and control parameters.

articleTitle: A novel inductorless solar pulse-reflex™ charger with maximum power point tracking
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: Gradual increase in use of solar power has drawn increased attention towards MPPT (Maximum Power Point Tracking) converters. However, there have been considerably lesser works that are concerned with the Lead-Acid storage. This paper presents an inductorless converter which facilitates fast charging and battery life extension with the help of Pulse and Reflex<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">™</sup> charging in addition to MPP operation. Two different control circuits have been developed using analog and microcontroller ICs, keeping in mind ease of fabrication, cost effectiveness and easier maintenance. Simulation and hardware results have been discussed.

articleTitle: Exponential coupled lines band-pass filter
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: In this paper, a theoretical analysis and design are presented of exponential coupled line, which operates as a wide band pass filter. The frequency response of the filter are verified by using a technique based on an artificial neural network and simulated by using CST STUDIO software. Simulation and Artificial neural network results show the proposed Exponential Coupled Lines Band-pass Filter can easily operate over ultra-wide band from 0 to 10 GHz.

articleTitle: Hybridized approach of artificial bee colony algorithm for detection of suspicious brain pattern using magnetic resonance images
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: Swarm intelligence based two optimization methods TABC and TABC-FPA has been discussed in this work for the segmentation and extraction of suspicious region from brain MR image. In these methods, TABC classifier uses texture features extracted from suspicious region as the source for classification. To improve the performance of TABC, TABC-FPA is proposed. In TABC-FPA hybridized approach the random local search operation of ABC is replaced by FPA technique of searching in neighborhood positions. Overall accuracy of TABC is 95.03% and that of TABC-FPA is 96.11%. In addition, the average execution time of TABC-FPA is reduced significantly when compared with TABC. The analysis indicates that the overall performance of TABC-FPA is appreciative.

articleTitle: Design, implementation and performance analysis of annular ring microstrip patch antenna for S band application
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: Microstrip patch antenna is basically an antenna having wider beam width together with narrow band. This antenna is fabricated with the help of etching process. This process will generate the patterns related to antennas which will be having lesser size and it will be joined together with metal trace which will be placed on an insulating surface made up of dielectric material. For forming the ground plane on the any side which we want, we will use a metal layer having continuity and it will be bonded with substrate material. Microstrip antenna has square, rectangular, circular, elliptical and annular ring which are general shapes. In this research we have studied the effect of antenna dimensions which includes antenna Length (L) and Dielectric constant which will play an important role while studying the Radiation parameters related to Bandwidth and Return Loss[5][6]. For this purpose, CST platform has been used. The frequency band 2-4 GHz is assigned as S band which is used in the applications such as satellite, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, cellular phones etc. The proposed method has been applied on the annular ring microstrip patch antenna. The results have been shown for the antenna in simulated manner as well as practical results.

articleTitle: Collective animal behavior algorithm for optimal reactive power dispatch problems
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: This paper proposes collective animal behavior (CAB) algorithm for solving optimal reactive power dispatch (ORPD) problem of power systems. Typically, ORPD is defined as the minimization of active power transmission losses and/or total voltage deviation (TVD) of load buses by controlling a number of control variables such as settings of generator voltages, tap positions of tap changing transformers and amount of reactive compensation. In this paper, CAB algorithm has been applied for this optimization problem of power systems. It has been applied to three standard power networks like IEEE 30-, 57- and 118-bus test power systems with the above objectives. Both economical (in the form of minimization of active power loss) as well as technical (in the form of minimization of TVD) benefits arisen are presented in this paper.

articleTitle: Sullage treatment of full solar energy process high way service of H2O in nano particles — Solar still waste water
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: In this paper is remove contamination of new techniques barriers for the utilization of sullage waste water treatment of produce in processing can be high way service of H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O at the same moving to waste water is for all disposal in solar still. The solar still has been developed in high efficiency produce in Vel Tech Multitech Engineering College at Chennai, Tamilnadu, India. The Experimental analysis of a solar still have been produced in more energy saving to internal heat transfer to high way service with help to nanoparticle (AL<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>) to a solar still. It is analyzed of one of the day in system have been given the 24 hr cycle, the total drip production of the proposed Nano - system is found to be 7.978 kg/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> day and without drip 5.234 kg/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> day and Overall efficiency in this system is 45%.

Author Keywords: Solar Thermal internal heat Transfer model

articleTitle: PLC based load shedding mechanism using battery SOC in micro grids
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: Renewable energy is clean, reliable and potentially very cheap once the technology improves. The renewable energy sources are not instantaneous as a result the storage plays an important role in renewable energy based microgrids. In addition to storage they are hybrid coupled with conventional sources such as the diesel generators to make them instantaneous supplier of power. The sizing of the microgrids will be based on the load profile obtained during the survey. If the load operation is not according to load profile, then it will affect the system operation and also the batteries. To avoid such mess, the PLC based load shedding mechanism is proposed which operates the load based on the battery SOC.

articleTitle: A FOAF ontology extension to meet online social networks presentation and analysis
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: The Online Social Networks (OSN) are networks resulting from social media users and interactions. Exploiting the semantic web technologies to present the OSN data, in this paper, we propose a FOAF ontology extension to participate to engineering a Unified Semantic Model for OSN. The Unified Semantic Model will permit modelling the OSN majority.

articleTitle: An IoT-based frontal collision avoidance system for railways
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: Railways are the best way of transport because of its efficiency; it takes people and goods in a bigger quantity simultaneously. Even though it is the best way of transportation frequent accidents affect its overall performance and it is happening due to drivers' carelessness, track problems, and the improper signaling. In this work, a frontal collision has been considered and a new approach called IoT based collision avoidance system (IoT-CAS) is introduced for identifying the trains on the same track. A vibration sensor is placed at the end of each branch for identifying the arrival and departure of the train in the particular branch. The IoT-CAS automatically updates the status of the track in the cloud. If an arrival signal is received from both the endpoints a caution message is sent to both the driver with audio and visual effect. Accordingly, IoT-CAS manages the situation and also identifies the train which is on the same track. An experimental setup has been developed and the results show that the IoT-CAS can be utilized for rail collision avoidance.

articleTitle: Small signal model of PV power generation system
