Later, the known electrical breaking methodologies are applied to the BLDC motor with novel modifications in the proposed MLI topology. Now the simulation studies with this modified MLI topology with different braking mechanisms employing BLDC drive shows better adaptability to the electric locomotives of the present day. The MATLAB SIMULINK simulation results of the corresponding experimentations are presented here with.

articleTitle: Unsupervised linear spectral unmixing of multispectral images using the NMF and modified-multilayer NMF algorithms
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: Spectral Unmixing of satellite images plays a major role in preparation of accurate maps. Here, the pixels are considered as Linearly mixed. The endmembers which contributes the unmixing accuracy is extracted using the Principal Component Analysis(PCA) algorithm. Non-negative Matrix Factorization(NMF) had been introduced in the unmixing process. Endmember dissimilarity Constraint is imposed on NMF. Multilayer Non-negative matrix factorization(MLNMF) uses the Vertex component Analysis for finding the initial Spectral matrix. In this paper, the Modified ML-NMF algorithm is used for finding the fraction images. Results obtained from both NMF and Modified MLNMF are compared and it shows that the proposed Modified ML-NMF algorithm unmix effectively which reduces the Root Mean Square Error by 15% and Reconstruction Error by 20%.

articleTitle: Optimized test data generation over suspicious implementation of oracle problem
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: The process of optimization can be improved through the range of Test input data which are given as an input to the build under test. The output of the testcase execution are evaluated. The document or procedure to clarify whether the test cases has passed or failed is called as “test oracle ”problem. The oracle problem helps to distinguish the correct behavior of the software from defective behavior of the software. The range of potential inputs can be very huge, even for a terribly small structures under test. We had used three different approach which do this without compromising on the coverage achieved. Testcases are generated and are checked with respect to the testcases expected behavior.

articleTitle: Precise measurement of power system frequency and phasor using SDFT and comparison with DFT based approach
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: Power system condition is reflected by frequency and phasor more accurately. State of power system is shown by phasor while real time balance between generation and load is reflected by frequency. Frequency undergoes variation from the standard value when there is a difference between generation of electrical power and load. Some power system protection and control applications, e.g., frequency relay for load shedding, load-frequency controller requires precise and fast estimation of the frequency. So frequency and phasor regarded as indices for the operating power system in practice. To gain efficient and safe operation of power system caused due to any significant variation from nominal frequency forces protective devices to take corrective actions. As phasor is important parameter in the frequency monitoring and control of power systems and it is not constant at off-nominal frequencies, its measurement at every instant in power system network with greater accuracy and fast speed is necessary. Discrete Fourier Transforms (DFT) is one of the most important tools in Digital Signal Processing (DSP). It can calculate signal's frequency spectrum, it can find system's frequency response and it allows systems to be analyzed in the frequency domain. Conventional DFT method produces errors in calculating phasor and frequency if frequency varies from standard value. Smart Discrete Fourier Transforms (SDFT) has all merits of DFT such as recursive computation, ease of implementation and real time suitability. SDFT also takes care of deviations in frequency, harmonics and noise. This paper presents a SDFT based algorithm for measuring frequency, amplitude and phase angle of an ac signal and its comparison with conventional DFT method. Different signals in the presence of noise and harmonics are tested with the presented algorithm.

articleTitle: Predictive learning model in cognitive radio using reinforcement learning
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: There is a sweeping change in the technology of wireless devices and application that tends to increase the demand of wireless spectrum. Conventional fixed spectrum allocation method is unable to satisfy the huge amount of spectrum needs resulting in bottleneck condition. To defeat from this problem Cognitive Radio is comes into the picture. Cognitive Radio is a wireless smart radio that can detect available idle channels in a wireless spectrum automatically and share these channels to secondary users and also get better radio operating behavior without interfering with primary users. In this paper we are studying a reinforcement learning technique to predict the throughput using the CACLA algorithm which is modified version of actor critic learning. The performance metrics of learning such as execution time, prediction accuracy and prediction error has been observed using MATLAB.

articleTitle: A study on economic load dispatch in power system in the environment perspective by PSO
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: The fundamental idea of any integrated power system is to operate more efficiently and at the same time to operate most economically. The cost of generation of real power at different generating units can be minimized for any given load demand. Apart from cost, environmental emission is also to be considered as growing emissions all over the world are creating a major havoc to living environment. So the idea of balanced economic and emission dispatch makes it a multi objective optimization problem to be solved. For solving this problem a well-known non-traditional PSO optimization is chosen, and 14bus and 30bus IEEE test systems are taken and simulated results are compared with genetic algorithm (GA).

articleTitle: Control of a mobile robot with Swedish wheels
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: This paper proposes a motion control study of a mobile robot-manipulator, provided with Swedish wheels. Was written the robot motion control differential equations, considering the wheels' slipping. It is proposed a mobile robot mathematical model construction, the movement control in different conditions of operation, and the mobile robot movement energy costs optimization.

articleTitle: Low cost ROS based semi-autonomous drone with position and altitude lock
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: In this paper, we have designed a quad copter which is cost effective and powered by ROS. The drone is capable of maintaining a constant altitude during hovering and a constant position for monitoring or surveillance. Robotic Operating System is implemented for trajectory tracking and telemetry. A low cost compact on-board embedded system powers the drone. Different controllers were implemented for position and altitude lock including PI and PID. The performance were compared and the results are also discussed in this paper.

articleTitle: A review on power quality improvement using AC to DC converters
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: Three-stage ac-dc converters are created to a developed level with enhanced power quality as far as power-factor amendment, lessened aggregate symphonious mutilation at input AC mains, and controlled dc yields to a buck, boost, buck — boost, multi-level, and multi-pulse modes with one-way and duplex power stream. This paper displays a partner finish survey of three-stage enhanced power quality ac-dc converter (IPQCs) setups, administration techniques, selection of components, similar elements, late patterns, their quality, and decision for particular applications. It's intended for introducing a best in class on the IPQC innovation to scientists, architects, and application engineers taking care of three-stage ac-dc converters.

articleTitle: High performance low power AHB DMA controller with FSM decomposition technique
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: AHB DMA Controller is used to transfer the data from AHB (Advance High Performance Bus) to Peripheral side and vice versa. This paper introduced the low power concept for reducing the power consumption during data transmission. In this paper, AHB DMA Controller working is scheduled by FSM (Finite State Machine) decomposition technique for reducing power. As per this technique, complete FSM of architecture of AHB DMA Controller is divided into two or more parts. After completion of this process, FSM Decomposition technique saves average 31.15 % Power during data transmission.

articleTitle: Voiceprint analysis for Parkinson's disease using MFCC, GMM, and instance based learning and multilayer perceptron
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: Parkinson's disease is a neurodegenerative disease. The key aspects of Parkinson's disease include disorders in voice production, phonation, nasality and sometimes leading to problems in respiration and the patterns of stress and intonation in a language. To efficiently detect the disorders the clinicians have given much importance to the acoustics of the analysis methods and from this frame of reference, voiceprint analysis has secured a unique platform among other detection methods. Different approaches are prevalent for the voiceprint analysis of Parkinson's disease but in this paper we would specifically concentrate on Mel Frequency Cepstral Coefficient (MFCC), Gaussian mixture model (GMM) and Instance based learning and their application in the field of Voiceprint Analysis. There are several other voiceprint analysis methods prevalent but this paper would specifically deal with the aforementioned methods as they are efficient and at the same time widely prevalent.

articleTitle: Indian accent detection using dynamic time warping
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: This investigation aims at designing an accent detection system by recognizing various accents as an input. It aims to identify the accent of a person from his or her voice. The different accents that are detected by the system are the native Indian accents like Bengali, Gujarati, Malayalam and Marathi. The features used for detecting the accents are Voice Onset Time (VOT) and Mel Frequency Cepstral Coefficients (MFCC). These features were extracted for the spoken words having unvoiced stops \p\, \t\, and \k\. Teager Energy Operator (TEO), which is a non linear energy tracking signal operator, is used for detecting the VOT. Thirteen MFCC features are extracted in the conventional way. The classifier used to detect the accented speech is Dynamic Time Warping (DTW) algorithm.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of wireless security system for railway tracks
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: This paper describes a system, basically an electronic system that can help us to detect the exact location of the crack which has been formed accidently or due to the terrorist activities. In India railway transportation occupies a very important role for connecting the entire country via different routes in the hilly regions, deserts, plateaus and all other extreme climatic conditions found all across the country to meet the ever-burgeoning needs of the growing economy. India has the fourth rank in terms of railway network in the world but in terms of safety and other technical advancements we have not yet achieved the specific position in the world.in this paper we are implementing a system that can locate the exact location of the crack on the track which will help to reduce the rail accidents which often leads to heavy loss of life and property. Advanced Niyantran is a cost effective solution to the problem of railway track crack detection utilizing IR sensor which tracks the exact location of faulty track and ultrasonic sensor which detects the obstacles in track which then quickly notified to the control room. So that many lives will be saved and the railways will not face any loss due to accidents hence creating a safer mode of transportation.

articleTitle: A new technique for AODV based secure routing with detection black hole in MANET
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: MANET is dynamic, self-organised and infrastructure less network. That has multiple nodes whose provide temporary infrastructure of nodes for establish connections and transfer information. According to MANET nature, there are many possible attacks, Black hole is one of them. MANET has various routing structure. AODV is reactive routing protocol. We have various techniques for maintains secure platform from attacks. But according to nature of network, there are high possibilities of attack malicious node. That is reason of loss packets. There are many technique, who's suggested by various experts. This paper work is related to identify malicious node with help of create black list and route addresses. In here HOP counts and SN used from previous techniques. Route addresses refers to route addresses and node addresses. Black list is list of inspected maliciously route. There will be helpful for ease identification of attacker nodes.

articleTitle: Smart electrical appliances controller using SMS
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: This article is about a simple low cost, small sized controller that helps people controlling their home appliances remotely even if they are outside their properties. The system lets them turn on or off any device while being outside home by sending messages using mobile phones. Moreover, a message could be sent to know more specific details like the temperature of the boiler, AC, etc. The main purpose of this system is to adapt with the private electricity subscription issue that almost all the Lebanese citizens are using to cope with the long electricity current cut off periods. However, the difference in payment rates between the normal current and that of the subscriber is always making a big concern over electricity consumption. Hence, the system will help users to minimize their payments for electricity usage by informing them if the current is on or off so they can control their appliances accordingly.

articleTitle: Maximum power point tracking controller for solar powered mUAV
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: Inage of Green energy revolution, solar energy comes into prominence in aerospace for providing fuel requirements for mini Unmanned Air Vehicle (mUAV). Conversion of this abundant solar energy into useable form will reduce the dependence on battery which is used in mUAV, while increasing the energy on board. In this work, an attempt has been made to model and simulate a photovoltaic cell with MPPT module and DC-DC converter. Photo voltaic cell works at highest efficiency when it is operating at its maximum power point. A DC-DC converter is used between the solar cell and the load as an interface. A boost converter is implemented as it serves the purpose of operating over the entire range of PV cell. The duty cycle is varied so that the impedance matching between the cell output and the load is achieved, by tracking the maximum power point of the cell. The idea is to ensure maximum performance of the setup, irrespective of the changes in physical conditions. Analysis is carried out with and without MPPT module to calculate efficiency. PV cell based renewable energy is more efficient with MPPT module as compared to without MPPT module.

articleTitle: A compilation of image fusion process using decision based coordinates of an image
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: Image fusion is a process in which the characteristics and quality of a low-resolution image are improved in accordance with the high-resolution image to get a fused image with more details than any of the excitation image. This paper proposes an implementation of an image fusion process using the image coordinates. At first, the image parameters are compiled from the acquisition image which has low and high resolution and those parameters are taken as an input and the transformation is processed, then the image registration is performed. The parallax correction and the decision-based computations are implemented further to get a fused image.

articleTitle: Design and performance analysis of rectangular microstrip patch antenna (RMPA) based on 3 different substrates at 2.5 GHz
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: In this paper a rectangular microstrip patch antenna (RMPA) has been designed on a single layer substrate. The main motive of this paper is to increase the low gain. Three different substrates have been used to analyze and differentiate the performance of the RMPA. The three substrates are Silica glass, Nickel, & Silver and the permittivity of the substrates are 3.8, 4.8544, and 3.0760 respectively. The proposed RMPA has been simulated which covers the range of 1 to 2.5GHz. The antenna is fabricated using Flame retardant (FR-4 lossy) substrate and a thickness of 1.5mm was used. The Microstrip line feed has been used for the feeding and hence the transmission line model is used to calculate the length and width of the antenna. Optimum values of the design parameters have been taken using trial and error methods with the purpose of acquiring precise measurements as well as the best possible features i.e. gain, directivity, operating frequency, efficiency etc.

articleTitle: Vibration signal analysis using time and timefrequency domain: Review
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: Machine plays an imperative part in the industries. Maintenance is an essential aspect for machineries, which is essential consistently. Condition monitoring & analysis of vibration signal is a prescient preservation procedure by which the deficiencies can be recognized in the machineries.in this paper, acquiring of data, analysis of signal & LABVIEW are utilized to recognize different faults which happens in the machineries. Thus necessary action can be taken on the machine ahead of time. In LABVIEW time domain & time-frequency domain investigation of signal is executed for process & analyzing the vibration signals. Spectrum analysis gives the more information about the type of the vibration signal, region & fault degree.

articleTitle: A new 15-level inverter configuration with fault tolerant capability for PV applications
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: Power generation using PV systems is becoming more popular due to lack of availability of fossil fuels. As power generated with PV system is DC, inverters are required to convert it into AC quantity. Conventional two-level inverters are popularly used in this application. But, the output voltage of these inverters contains more harmonic component which will deteriorates lifetime of the load. Moreover, if any one switch of two-level inverter fails, entire system has to be shutdown. To overcome these disadvantages, a novel 15-level inverter is proposed in this paper. The proposed inverter configuration is developed by using three isolated DC sources, six two-quadrant switches and four four-quadrant switches. Hence, this inverter requires only ten switching devices which is very less number compared to number of switches required in conventional 15-level inerter. As availability of isolated dc sources are common in case of different PV system modules, three dc sources can be easily obtained. The proposed inverter is simulated in MATLAB/Simulink and results are presented. The analysis is carried to study the behavior of the inverter during the failure of some switching devices and Dc sources. This configuration can be extended to get more number of voltage levels by cascading proposed inverter units.

articleTitle: Reconfiguration of electrical distribution network for loss reduction and voltage enhancement
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: This paper recommends a new technique for reconfiguration of the network based on Loss Sensitivity Factor to decide the switching combinations and to achieve best combination of switches for minimum active power loss, as well as improvement in voltage profile that progresses the voltage stability in ERDS (Electrical Radial Distribution Systems). The impact of the proposed algorithm has been tested for 33-bus Radial Distribution System.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of a sign-to-speech/text system for deaf and dumb people
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: This paper shows an approach for outlining and executing a savvy glove for hard of hearing and unable to speak individuals. There have been a few looks into done keeping in mind the end goal to locate a less demanding route for non-vocal individuals to speak with vocal individuals and convey what needs be to the hearing scene. Advancements have been made in gesture based communication yet basically in American Sign Language. This exploration plans to build up a communication via gestures interpreter in view of savvy glove interfaced remotely with microcontroller and content/voice showing gadgets. An approach has been created and modified to hear the gesture based communication. The entire framework has been executed, customized, cased and tried with great outcomes.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of high gain boost converter with voltage-mode control
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: This paper presents modeling, design and implementation of a high gain boost DC-DC converter and its closed loop control. A simple voltage mode analog controller is designed to regulate the output voltage of the converter. Small signal model of the converter is derived from average state space analysis. The operation of the converter under steady state and transient are validated experimentally. A hardware prototype of 50 Watt, 200V output voltage, 20kHz boost converter with an input of 12V is developed. The output voltage of dc-dc boost converter is regulated with wide load variation (from 56.52% to 108.70% of full load).

articleTitle: Adaptive secret key generation in underwater acoustic system
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: Pre-set secret keys are generally used to encipher and decipher the message in communication systems, including underwater acoustic (UWA) systems. Communication is not secure if the keys are compromised, so we need to generate an adaptive shared secret key. The secret keys are generated adaptively using correlated channel estimation, which reckons on the randomness in the environment and does not require the secrecy of data transferred during the process. This concept is extended in UWA channels with orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (OFDM) systems and implements a protocol to generate secret keys adaptively based on the channel frequency response (CFR). A secret key generated from the CFR estimation manages the channel coding system, namely a turbo-code. This scheme allows to jointly performing an error control and adaptive coding in only one step. This scheme allows an adaptive security coding without change of the hardware structure of the transceiver devices. In our analysis, BER is used as a measure of the performance of channel estimation and mutual information is used as a measure of secretkey performance.

articleTitle: Mathematical analysis & modeling of Li-Ion battery with PMSM based plug-in electric vehicles
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: This paper aims to study of existing E-Vehicular Technologies which are available. Out of which a better suitable vehicular system with less complex design and easy control is opted for the mathematical analysis. In this paper, to avoid charging and discharging delays in the existing Energy Storage System of Plug-in Electric Vehicles, the Li-ion battery is used. The PMSM with Bi-directional converter simulation results of PEV presented to verify the maximum efficiency at different operating voltages of Li-ion battery.

articleTitle: BER performance evaluation of cognitive radio network using M-ary PSK over Rayleigh fading channel
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: Cognitive radio technology has come out to solve the problem of bandwidth scarcity by allowing the unlicensed users to use the licensed bands opportunistically. Spectrum sensing is the basic and essential mechanisms of Cognitive Radio to find the unused Spectrum. This paper, focus on the performance evaluation of energy detection spectrum sensing of cognitive radio network in term of bit error rate versus signal to noise ratio for M-ary phase shift keying modulation schemes, over Rayleigh fading channel and AWGN. The cognitive radio network was designed firstly as computer model showed the sequence of processes in cognitive radio system and then the simulation of cognitive radio network was performed using MATLAB simulation. The results show that as the number of Mary increase the bit error rate increased while the bit error rate decreased as the signal to noise ratio increased.

articleTitle: GUI-based user behavior intrusion detection
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: Today all users depend on the computer in their daily life, for simple tasks such as checking Our studies in this paper describe an approach for identifying an intruder by his/her behavior on GUI based system. Our system introduces logger to collect user log and BIDS detector. BIDS detector is program who create an initial user profile as well as update it if needed. BIDS program also use a t-test for identifying the user behavior deviation. Our system can be efficiently used while intruder pretending to be authorized the user and gives high detection rates with less false positives.

articleTitle: Minimization of error rate for cooperative spectrum sensing in cognitive radio networks
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: We devised a pre-handoff spectrum sensing optimization in cognitive radio network. In this, we consider allied spectrum sensing where multiple cognitive radios jointly detect the spectrum holes through optimal voting rule for a fixed value of secondary users in order to observe and investigate the optimality of spectrum sensing and therefore, enhancing the detection performance in an efficient way. This is done by finding out the optimal value of cognitive radios out of the given lot, thereby reducing the total error rate. In this method, incorporated measurement and simulation using MATLAB (R2015a) software were implemented.

articleTitle: Importance of fly back converter for electric vehicles
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to design a fly back converter that has an input voltage of 5V dc and the output voltage of 15V dc. Fly back converter is one of the switching dc power supplies applications with electrical isolation. The transformation of dc voltage from 5V dc to 15V dc is accomplished by using dc-to-dc converter circuits. The switching element used in this fly back converter is MOSFET, which is the operating completely off or completely on. The output of the MOSFET is fed to high frequency transformer. The input voltage of 5V dc will be step up to 15V dc. A high-frequency isolation transformer provides the electrical isolation in fly back converter. The high frequency transformers were used due to the small size and small weight. Consequently, the design circuit will deliver accurate output value with low power losses. On the whole, the undertaken task would provide to understand the operation of the fly back converter circuit practically.

articleTitle: VNC server based robot for military applications
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: This innovative system is made for operations which have high risk for the men to enter at any zone, especially for some case like bomb blast and this may prove very beneficial for military area for spying purposes. This system makes use of robotic arm as well as robotic vehicle which helps to diffuse the bombs, not only to diffuse but to dispose also by entering an area involving high risk to pick the bomb it wants to and carry it to safer zone. The robot includes night vision camera which will view whatever will seen by the robot in day time but also during night time. The system also includes IR sensor which will detect the obstacle comes in its path, this will tend the robot to move opposite direction for a while to protect its arms by getting accidental damage. The whole system can be controlled via android application or laptops with the help of server. The system sends commands to the receiving circuit mounted on the vehicle through Internet. The receiving circuit involves Raspberry pi microcontroller with Wi-Fi enabled which receives commands through internet sent by the server called as VNC server. The android application or laptops involves buttons K, L, M, N, O, and F so as to control the robotic arm. The user can press the desired buttons in order to control the movement of vehicle. Thus this application involves both Robotic arm and Robotic vehicle so that the system can not only be used to enter a high risk area but also to pick, move and place whichever objects it wants to. Each and every movement of the robot will be recorded and can be viewed in a PC wirelessly by the operator.

articleTitle: Developing an electronic commerce platform
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: Electronic Commerce applications support the interaction between various parties participating in a commerce transaction as well as the management of the data involved in the process via the network or the internet. Electronic commerce is gaining traction as an acknowledged and used business model. More and more corporates are implementing web sites providing functionality for performing commercial transactions over the internet to better reach customers as it is sensible to say that the process of shopping on the web is becoming common. In this article we intend to discuss the background for developing an electronic commerce application, principles and methods involved in developing an ecommerce application.

articleTitle: Design and analysis of H shaped microstrip antenna with different feed position and number of slots for multiband applications
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)

authors.preferredName: N V S S Arun Varma

abstract: Due to the advent use of Microstrip antenna in various applications such as weather radars, broadband and satellite applications.it has become a solid candidate for research. All the applications can be served by a single Microstrip patch antenna when it acts in multiband frequencies. Each application requires some specifications to be fulfilled such as high gain for satellite and broadband applications such as High return loss for impedance matching networks. But effectiveness in one parameter definitely affects the other parameters so that a single multiband antenna will not be used for various applications. The key factor in designing a patch antenna is the feed position and number of slots present in the design. so A design has been proposed for H shaped Microstrip antenna with ‘I’ slots concentrating on multiband applications and various parameters have been analysed like two different feed points (at the centre and off the centre) and also by increasing number of slots from 1 to 3. The results have been simulated by using HFSS software. Antenna parameters is compared for multiband frequencies (S, C, X bands).with this analysis, variation of antenna parameters at various feed positions and due to increase in number of slots can be determined.

articleTitle: Performance analysis of pulse shape filter for repetition channel coding
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Power, Control, Signals and Instrumentation Engineering (ICPCSI)
abstract: Pulse shaping filters in communication system is used for generating bandlimited channel and reducing inter symbol interference(ISI). By applying pulse shaping filter to the modulated signal, sharp transitions in the signal are levelled and the signal is limited to specific frequency band. In this paper the performances of different pulse shaping filters, are analyzed with 1/3 repetition channel coding for various modulation schemes. The channel coding along with the proposed filter is simulated using labview simulator. Bit Error Rate (BER) and Eye pattern for various modulation schemes in AWGN channel have been analyzed in this paper.
